15.4.8.a.s: yadi bhidyeta gāyatryā tvā śatākṣarayā saṃdadhāmi \\ iti tat saṃdhāya \\ abhinno gharmas \\ ity abhimantryāpo 'bhyāvahṛtyāthānyat kapālam̐ sam̐skṛtya tad vā piṣṭvān yayā mṛdā karaṇīyayā kṛtvā gharmo devām̐ apyetu \\ iti kapāleṣv apisṛjati // yadi prāg upadhānād bhidyeta //
15.4.8.a.d: यदि भिद्येत गायत्र्या त्वा शताक्षरया संदधामि \\ इति तत् संधाय \\ अभिन्नो घर्मस् \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्यापो ऽभ्यावहृत्याथान्यत् कपालम्̐ सम्̐स्कृत्य तद् वा पिष्ट्वान् यया मृदा करणीयया कृत्वा घर्मो देवाम्̐ अप्येतु \\ इति कपालेष्व् अपिसृजति ॥ यदि प्राग् उपधानाद् भिद्येत ॥
15.4.8.a.m: If it should break, having joined it with “I join you with the gāyatrī of a hundred syllables,” having touched it with “Unbroken is the caldron,” and having thrown [the pieces] into water, then having consecrated another potsherd, or having pulverized that [broken one] and formed [a new one] with other clay suitable for making, he puts it among the potsherds with “May the caldron go to the gods”—if it breaks before the laying down [of the potsherds].

15.4.9.a.m: Now, if [one breaks] among those already laid down, he should lay it down with this very mantra.

15.4.10.a.s: vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped yadi patnī saṃyājayan kapālam abhijuhuyāt //
15.4.10.a.d: वैश्वानरं द्वादशकपालं निर्वपेद् यदि पत्नी संयाजयन् कपालम् अभिजुहुयात् ॥
15.4.10.a.m: He should offer [a sacrificial cake] on twelve potsherds to Vaiśvānara if, while performing the Patnīsaṃyājas, he makes an oblation over a potsherd.

15.4.11.a.s: etām eva nirvapet putro jāta etām eva nirvaped yo darśapūrṇamāsayājī sann amāvāsyāṃ vā paurṇamāsīṃ vātipādayet //
15.4.11.a.d: एताम् एव निर्वपेत् पुत्रो जात एताम् एव निर्वपेद् यो दर्शपूर्णमासयाजी सन्न् अमावास्यां वा पौर्णमासीं वातिपादयेत् ॥
15.4.11.a.m: He should offer this very [cake] when a son is born; he should offer this very [cake] if, being a performer of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, he should omit either the New Moon or the Full Moon rite.

15.4.12.a.s: etām eva nirvaped yad aniṣṭvāgrayaṇena navasyāśnīyāt //
15.4.12.a.d: एताम् एव निर्वपेद् यद् अनिष्ट्वाग्रयणेन नवस्याश्नीयात् ॥
15.4.12.a.m: He should offer this very [cake] if, without having offered the Āgrayaṇa, he should eat of the new grain.

15.4.13.a.s: ānīto vā eṣa devānāṃ ya āhitāgnir adanty asya devā annam / yad akṛtvāgrayaṇaṃ navāsyāśnīyād devebhyo bhāgaṃ pratikḷptam adyād ārtim ārchet //
15.4.13.a.d: आनीतो वा एष देवानां य आहिताग्निर् अदन्त्य् अस्य देवा अन्नम् । यद् अकृत्वाग्रयणं नवास्याश्नीयाद् देवेभ्यो भागं प्रतिकॢप्तम् अद्याद् आर्तिम् आर्छेत् ॥
15.4.13.a.m: He who has established the sacred fires has indeed been brought near to the gods; the gods eat his food. If, without having performed the Āgrayaṇa, he should eat of the new grain, he would eat the portion apportioned to the gods [and] would meet with misfortune.

15.4.14.a.s: mārutaṃ trayodaśakapālaṃ nirvaped yasya putrau yamau jāyetāṃ gāvau vā //
15.4.14.a.d: मारुतं त्रयोदशकपालं निर्वपेद् यस्य पुत्रौ यमौ जायेतां गावौ वा ॥
15.4.14.a.m: He should offer [a sacrificial cake] on thirteen potsherds to the Maruts, for whom twin sons or twin calves are born.

15.4.15.a.s: nirvīryatāṃ vai jātaḥ puruṣa āśāste 'paśutāṃ gauḥ //
15.4.15.a.d: निर्वीर्यतां वै जातः पुरुष आशास्ते ऽपशुतां गौः ॥
15.4.15.a.m: A man born [as a twin] hopes for virility; a cow [born as a twin hopes] for cattle-wealth.

15.4.16.a.m: The introductory verse is in the gāyatrī [meter]; the offering verse is in the triṣṭubh [meter].

15.4.17.a.m: Some teach [an offering] on three potsherds to Viṣṇu.

15.4.18.a.s: āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped yasyānyam agniṣu yājayeyur yo vā yajeta //
15.4.18.a.d: आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपेद् यस्यान्यम् अग्निषु याजयेयुर् यो वा यजेत ॥
15.4.18.a.m: He should offer [a sacrificial cake] on eleven potsherds to Agni-and-Viṣṇu, on whose fires they make another sacrifice, or who [himself] sacrifices [on another's fires].

15.4.19.a.s: raudraṃ vāstumayaṃ caruṃ nirvaped yatra paśupatiḥ paśūñ chamayeta //
15.4.19.a.d: रौद्रं वास्तुमयं चरुं निर्वपेद् यत्र पशुपतिः पशूञ् छमयेत ॥
15.4.19.a.m: He should offer a mess of wild rice to Rudra where the lord of animals slays animals.

15.4.20.a.m: With this [rite] he should cause a Niṣāda chieftain to sacrifice.

15.4.21.a.s: kṛṣṇājinaṃ vā kūṭaṃ vākarṇo vā gardabho dakṣiṇā / hariṇo vā hariṇapṛṇākā vā śyāmākapātro vā / dve vākyāmbū śūrpe śayyāṃ vā / sā hi tasyeṣṭiḥ //
15.4.21.a.d: कृष्णाजिनं वा कूटं वाकर्णो वा गर्दभो दक्षिणा । हरिणो वा हरिणपृणाका वा श्यामाकपात्रो वा । द्वे वाक्याम्बू शूर्पे शय्यां वा । सा हि तस्येष्टिः ॥
15.4.21.a.m: A black antelope skin, or a hornless animal, or a crop-eared donkey is the sacrificial fee; or a deer, or a deer-skin garment, or a vessel of wild millet; or two winnowing-baskets of water-beans, or a couch; for that is his sacrifice.

15.4.22.a.s: yo brahmacārī striyam upeyāt sa gardabhaṃ paśum ālabheta //
15.4.22.a.d: यो ब्रह्मचारी स्त्रियम् उपेयात् स गर्दभं पशुम् आलभेत ॥
15.4.22.a.m: A Vedic student who has sexual intercourse with a woman should offer an ass as a sacrificial animal.

15.4.23.a.m: On the ground he cooks the animal-cake on one potsherd.

15.4.24.a.m: They should proceed with the cut portions into water.

15.4.25.a.s: nairṛtaḥ prājāpatyo vā / rakṣodevata ity ekeṣām / yamadevata ity ekeṣām //
15.4.25.a.d: नैरृतः प्राजापत्यो वा । रक्षोदेवत इत्य् एकेषाम् । यमदेवत इत्य् एकेषाम् ॥
15.4.25.a.m: [The animal] belongs to Nirṛti, or to Prajāpati; according to some it has the Rakṣases as deity; according to some it has Yama as deity.

15.4.26.a.s: yasya haviḥ kṣāyati taṃ yajñaṃ nirṛtir gṛhṇāti yadā tad dhaviḥ saṃtiṣṭheta / atha tad eva haviḥ punar nirvapet //
15.4.26.a.d: यस्य हविः क्षायति तं यज्ञं निरृतिर् गृह्णाति यदा तद् धविः संतिष्ठेत । अथ तद् एव हविः पुनर् निर्वपेत् ॥
15.4.26.a.m: When a person's sacrificial oblation is charred, Nirṛti seizes that sacrifice. When that sacrificial oblation is concluded, then he should offer that very sacrificial oblation again.

15.4.27.a.s: yajño yajñasya prāyaścittir yad ucchiṣṭam̐ syāt // tena sam̐sthāpayet / yaṃ dviṣyāt tasmai tāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt / tam eva nirṛtyā grāhayati //
15.4.27.a.d: यज्ञो यज्ञस्य प्रायश्चित्तिर् यद् उच्छिष्टम्̐ स्यात् ॥ तेन सम्̐स्थापयेत् । यं द्विष्यात् तस्मै तां दक्षिणां दद्यात् । तम् एव निरृत्या ग्राहयति ॥
15.4.27.a.m: Sacrifice is the expiation of sacrifice. Whatever may be the remainder, with that he should conclude [the rite]. To him whom he hates he should give that sacrificial fee; him indeed he causes Nirṛti to seize.

15.4.28.a.s: yathākathā ca kṣāyet prāyaścittim eva syāt //
15.4.28.a.d: यथाकथा च क्षायेत् प्रायश्चित्तिम् एव स्यात् ॥
15.4.28.a.m: In whatever way it is charred, an expiation alone should be performed.

15.4.29.a.m: Or if it is not sufficient for the cut portions [an expiation is performed].

15.4.30.a.s: yady aprattadaivatam̐ havir vyāpadyetāthānyat taddaivatam̐ havir abhyudāharet //
15.4.30.a.d: यद्य् अप्रत्तदैवतम्̐ हविर् व्यापद्येताथान्यत् तद्दैवतम्̐ हविर् अभ्युदाहरेत् ॥
15.4.30.a.m: If a sacrificial oblation whose deity has not been assigned is spoiled, then he should bring forward another sacrificial oblation intended for that deity.

15.4.31.a.m: In that case, the mantras beginning with the taking up of the ladle should be repeated.

15.4.32.a.m: Or up to whatever stage it is spoiled [he repeats the rites].

15.4.33.a.s: yadi tu prattadaivatam ājyena śeṣam̐ sam̐sthāpayet //
15.4.33.a.d: यदि तु प्रत्तदैवतम् आज्येन शेषम्̐ सम्̐स्थापयेत् ॥
15.4.33.a.m: If, however, the deity has been assigned, he should conclude the remainder with clarified butter.

15.4.34.a.s: yasya sarvāṇi havīm̐ṣi // naśyeyur vā duṣyeyur vāpahareyur vājyena devatāḥ pratisaṃkhyāya yajeta //
15.4.34.a.d: यस्य सर्वाणि हवीम्̐षि ॥ नश्येयुर् वा दुष्येयुर् वापहरेयुर् वाज्येन देवताः प्रतिसंख्याय यजेत ॥
15.4.34.a.m: If all the sacrificial oblations of someone are lost, or spoiled, or stolen, having recited the deities in order, he should sacrifice with clarified butter.

15.4.35.a.s: athānyām iṣṭim anulbaṇāṃ tanvīta / yajño hi yajñasya prāyaścittiḥ //
15.4.35.a.d: अथान्याम् इष्टिम् अनुल्बणां तन्वीत । यज्ञो हि यज्ञस्य प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
15.4.35.a.m: Then he should perform another faultless sacrifice; for sacrifice is the expiation of sacrifice.

15.4.36.a.m: “He conveys the spoiled sacrificial oblation into water,” thus it is known from the sacred text.

15.4.37.a.s: yad āryāṇām abhojanīyaṃ syān na tena yajeta //
15.4.37.a.d: यद् आर्याणाम् अभोजनीयं स्यान् न तेन यजेत ॥
15.4.37.a.m: What is inedible for Āryas, with that he should not sacrifice.

15.4.38.a.s: yad dhavir duḥśṛtaṃ yamadevatyaṃ tad yamam eva gacchatīti sam̐sthāpya tad anvāhāryapacane catuḥśarāvam odanaṃ paktvā caturo brāhmaṇān bhojayet //
15.4.38.a.d: यद् धविर् दुःशृतं यमदेवत्यं तद् यमम् एव गच्छतीति सम्̐स्थाप्य तद् अन्वाहार्यपचने चतुःशरावम् ओदनं पक्त्वा चतुरो ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेत् ॥
15.4.38.a.m: The sacrificial oblation that is improperly cooked belongs to Yama; that goes to Yama alone. Concluding that [rite], having cooked a mess of four cups of rice on the anvāhāryapacana fire, he should feed four brahmins.

15.4.39.a.s: teṣāṃ bhārgava ekaḥ prāśitṝṇām̐ syāt tebhyaḥ samāno varo deyaḥ / sā prāyaścittiḥ //
15.4.39.a.d: तेषां भार्गव एकः प्राशितॄणाम्̐ स्यात् तेभ्यः समानो वरो देयः । सा प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
15.4.39.a.m: One of those eaters should be a descendant of Bhṛgu; to them a common boon should be given. That is the expiation.

15.4.40.a.s: yo 'dakṣiṇena yajñena yajeta / sa yajñaḥ prakṣāmo 'nāyur varā pratiṣṭhitā deyā sā prāyaścittiḥ //
15.4.40.a.d: यो ऽदक्षिणेन यज्ञेन यजेत । स यज्ञः प्रक्षामो ऽनायुर् वरा प्रतिष्ठिता देया सा प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
15.4.40.a.m: Whoever sacrifices with a sacrifice without a fee, that sacrifice of his is consumed by fire and brings no long life; a cultivated field established as a boon should be given. That is the expiation.

15.4.41.a.s: yady ādiṣṭāṃ dakṣiṇām antariyād urvarāṃ dadyāt sā prāyaścittiḥ //
15.4.41.a.d: यद्य् आदिष्टां दक्षिणाम् अन्तरियाद् उर्वरां दद्यात् सा प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
15.4.41.a.m: If he fails to provide the specified sacrificial fee, he should give a fertile field. That is the expiation.

15.4.42.a.s: yady abhāgāṃ devatām āvāhayed ājyenaināṃ yathoḍhāṃ yajeta / purastād vā sviṣṭakṛtaḥ //
15.4.42.a.d: यद्य् अभागां देवताम् आवाहयेद् आज्येनैनां यथोढां यजेत । पुरस्ताद् वा स्विष्टकृतः ॥
15.4.42.a.m: If he invokes a deity that has no share, he should worship it with clarified butter in the regular order, or before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

15.4.43.a.s: yadi bhāginīṃ nāvāhayed yadopasmaret tad upotthāya manasāvāhayet \\ yad vo devā atipādayāni \\ ity āhutiṃ juhuyāt //
15.4.43.a.d: यदि भागिनीं नावाहयेद् यदोपस्मरेत् तद् उपोत्थाय मनसावाहयेत् \\ यद् वो देवा अतिपादयानि \\ इत्य् आहुतिं जुहुयात् ॥
15.4.43.a.m: If he does not invoke a deity that has a share, whenever he remembers, rising up beside [the fire] he should invoke it mentally [and] offer an oblation with: “Whatever of you, O gods, I may omit…”

15.4.44.a.s: yasya havyaṃ niruptam̐ skanded ājyaṃ vā gṛhītaṃ citraṃ deyam / varo deya ity ekeṣām //
15.4.44.a.d: यस्य हव्यं निरुप्तम्̐ स्कन्देद् आज्यं वा गृहीतं चित्रं देयम् । वरो देय इत्य् एकेषाम् ॥
15.4.44.a.m: If the sacrificial material that has been poured out spills, or the clarified butter that has been taken [into the ladle], a variegated [animal] should be given; a boon should be given, according to some.

15.4.45.a.s: yasyai devatāyai gṛhītam ahutam̐ skanded yad asya gṛhe puṣkalam̐ syāt tad dadyāt //
15.4.45.a.d: यस्यै देवतायै गृहीतम् अहुतम्̐ स्कन्देद् यद् अस्य गृहे पुष्कलम्̐ स्यात् तद् दद्यात् ॥
15.4.45.a.m: For whichever deity [an oblation] taken [into the ladle] spills without being offered, whatever may be abundant in his house, that he should give.

15.4.46.a.s: yady āhutī viparihareyur mano jyotir juṣatām ity āhutiṃ juhuyāt //
15.4.46.a.d: यद्य् आहुती विपरिहरेयुर् मनो ज्योतिर् जुषताम् इत्य् आहुतिं जुहुयात् ॥
15.4.46.a.m: If they transpose two oblations, he should offer an oblation with: “May the mind enjoy the light…”

15.4.47.a.s: yasya devate avadāne vā yājyānuvākye vā viparihareyus tvaṃ no agne \ sa tvaṃ no agne \\ ity etābhyām̐ saṃtatiṃ juhuyāt / sarvatrāntarite viparīte ca //
15.4.47.a.d: यस्य देवते अवदाने वा याज्यानुवाक्ये वा विपरिहरेयुस् त्वं नो अग्ने \ स त्वं नो अग्ने \\ इत्य् एताभ्याम्̐ संततिं जुहुयात् । सर्वत्रान्तरिते विपरीते च ॥
15.4.47.a.m: For whom the two deities, or the two cut portions, or the offering and introductory verses are transposed, he should offer a continuous offering with these two: “You to us, O Agni…” [and] “So you to us, O Agni…”; wherever there is an omission or a reversal.

15.4.48.a.s: yadi bahiṣparidhy āhutiṃ skanded āgnīdhraṃ brūyāt \\ etām̐ saṃkṛṣya juhudhi \\ iti / tām̐ so 'ñjalinā saṃkṛṣya juhuyāt \\ mā yajamāno riṣan mā patnī mā yajño mā yajñapatiḥ svāhā \\ iti tasmai pūrṇapātraṃ dadyāt // sā prāyaścittiḥ //
15.4.48.a.d: यदि बहिष्परिध्य् आहुतिं स्कन्देद् आग्नीध्रं ब्रूयात् \\ एताम्̐ संकृष्य जुहुधि \\ इति । ताम्̐ सो ऽञ्जलिना संकृष्य जुहुयात् \\ मा यजमानो रिषन् मा पत्नी मा यज्ञो मा यज्ञपतिः स्वाहा \\ इति तस्मै पूर्णपात्रं दद्यात् ॥ सा प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
15.4.48.a.m: If an oblation spills outside the enclosing sticks, he should say to the āgnīdhra: “Having gathered this together, offer [it]!” Having gathered it together with his joined palms, he should offer it with: “May the sacrificer not suffer harm, nor the wife, nor the sacrifice, nor the lord of the sacrifice, svāhā!” To him he should give a full vessel. That is the expiation.

15.4.49.a.s: yadi puroḍāśa ud vā patet sa vā vijeta tam antarvedy āsādya kim utpatāsi kim utproṣṭhāḥ \ śāntaḥ śānter ihāgahi / \ aghoro yajñiyo bhūtvā \\ ā sīda sadanam̐ svam \ ā sīda sadanam̐ svam \\ mā him̐sīr deva preṣitas \\ ājyena tejasājyasva \ mā naḥ kiṃcana rīriṣas \\ yogakṣemasya śāntyai \\ asminn āsīda barhiṣi \\ iti tam etena yajuṣābhimantrayed abhi vāghārayet //
15.4.49.a.d: यदि पुरोडाश उद् वा पतेत् स वा विजेत तम् अन्तर्वेद्य् आसाद्य किम् उत्पतासि किम् उत्प्रोष्ठाः \ शान्तः शान्तेर् इहागहि । \ अघोरो यज्ञियो भूत्वा \\ आ सीद सदनम्̐ स्वम् \ आ सीद सदनम्̐ स्वम् \\ मा हिम्̐सीर् देव प्रेषितस् \\ आज्येन तेजसाज्यस्व \ मा नः किंचन रीरिषस् \\ योगक्षेमस्य शान्त्यै \\ अस्मिन्न् आसीद बर्हिषि \\ इति तम् एतेन यजुषाभिमन्त्रयेद् अभि वाघारयेत् ॥
15.4.49.a.m: If a sacrificial cake should fly up or tremble, placing it inside the altar, he should consecrate it with this yajus mantra or sprinkle it with clarified butter: “Why would you fly up? Why would you leap up? / Pacified, come here from pacification. / Having become benevolent and worthy of sacrifice, // sit upon your own seat; / sit upon your own seat. // Do not cause injury, sent forth by the god. // Be anointed with clarified butter, with radiance. / Do not harm anything of ours; // for the pacification of acquisition and preservation, // sit upon this sacred grass!”

15.4.50.a.s: bhūtvā prabhavati yajamāno yasyaitāṃ yajñe prāyaścittiṃ kurvanti //
15.4.50.a.d: भूत्वा प्रभवति यजमानो यस्यैतां यज्ञे प्रायश्चित्तिं कुर्वन्ति ॥
15.4.50.a.m: The sacrificer prospers, becoming successful, for whom they perform this expiation in the sacrifice.

15.5.1.a.s: agniṃ naro dīdhitibhir araṇyor \ hastacyutī janayanta praśastam / \ dūredṛśaṃ gṛhapatim atharyum / \ agnināgniḥ samidhyate \ sapta te agne \ mano jyotir juṣatām \\ trayastrim̐śat \\ yan me manasaś chidram \\ yad vāco yac ca me hṛdaḥ / \ ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ \ saṃ tat siñcatu rādhasā //
15.5.1.a.d: अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिर् अरण्योर् \ हस्तच्युती जनयन्त प्रशस्तम् । \ दूरेदृशं गृहपतिम् अथर्युम् । \ अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यते \ सप्त ते अग्ने \ मनो ज्योतिर् जुषताम् \\ त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शत् \\ यन् मे मनसश् छिद्रम् \\ यद् वाचो यच् च मे हृदः । \ अयं देवो बृहस्पतिः \ सं तत् सिञ्चतु राधसा ॥
15.5.1.a.m: “Men with their reflections produced the praised Agni / from the two firesticks by the churning of their hands, / the far-seeing lord of the house, Atharvan.” / “Agni is kindled by Agni.” / “Seven are yours, O Agni.” / “May the mind enjoy the light.” / “Thirty-three.” / “Whatever flaw of my mind, / whatever of speech, and whatever of my heart, / may this divine Bṛhaspati / fill it up with abundance.”

15.5.1.b.s: viśvakarmā havir idaṃ juṣāṇaḥ \ saṃtānair yajñam̐ sam imaṃ tanotu / \ yā vyuṣṭā uṣaso yāś ca yājyās \ tāḥ saṃdadhāmi haviṣā ghṛtena / \ ayāś cāgne / \ tvaṃ no agne / \ sa tvaṃ no agne /
15.5.1.b.d: विश्वकर्मा हविर् इदं जुषाणः \ संतानैर् यज्ञम्̐ सम् इमं तनोतु । \ या व्युष्टा उषसो याश् च याज्यास् \ ताः संदधामि हविषा घृतेन । \ अयाश् चाग्ने । \ त्वं नो अग्ने । \ स त्वं नो अग्ने ।
15.5.1.b.m: “Viśvakarman, enjoying this sacrificial oblation, / let him unite this sacrifice with continuous extensions. / The dawns that have shone forth and the verses that are to be offered, / those I unite with the sacrificial oblation, with ghee.” / “And, O Agni, ayās.” / “You, O Agni, to us.” / “So you to us, O Agni.”

15.5.1.c.s: bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devās \\ bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhir yajatrāḥ / \ sthirair aṅgais tuṣṭuvām̐sas tanūbhir \ vyaśema devahitaṃ yad āyuḥ /
15.5.1.c.d: भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवास् \\ भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर् यजत्राः । \ स्थिरैर् अङ्गैस् तुष्टुवाम्̐सस् तनूभिर् \ व्यशेम देवहितं यद् आयुः ।
15.5.1.c.m: “May we hear what is auspicious with our ears, O gods; / may we see what is auspicious with our eyes, O holy ones. / Praising with firm limbs and bodies, / may we attain the life-span appointed by the gods.”

15.5.1.d.s: svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ \ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ \ svasti nas tārkṣyo ariṣṭenamiḥ \ svasti no bṛhaspatir dadhātu /
15.5.1.d.d: स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवाः \ स्वस्ति नः पूषा विश्ववेदाः \ स्वस्ति नस् तार्क्ष्यो अरिष्टेनमिः \ स्वस्ति नो बृहस्पतिर् दधातु ।
15.5.1.d.m: “May Indra of extensive renown grant us well-being; / may Pūṣan, knower of all, grant us well-being; / may Tārkṣya, with uninjured felly, grant us well-being; / may Bṛhaspati grant us well-being.”

15.5.1.e.s: pṛṣadaśvā marutaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ \ śubhaṃyāvāno vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ / agnijihvā manavaḥ sūracakṣasas \\ viśve no devā avasāgamann iha /
15.5.1.e.d: पृषदश्वा मरुतः पृश्निमातरः \ शुभंयावानो विदथेषु जग्मयः । अग्निजिह्वा मनवः सूरचक्षसस् \\ विश्वे नो देवा अवसागमन्न् इह ।
15.5.1.e.m: “The Maruts having spotted horses, born of Pṛśni, / moving with splendor, frequenters at assemblies, / having Agni for their tongue, wise, sun-eyed: / may all the gods come here with their protection.”

15.5.1.f.s: śatam in nu śarado anti devās \\ yatrā naś cakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām / \ putrāso yatra pitaro madanti \ mā no madhyā rīriṣatāyur gantoḥ /
15.5.1.f.d: शतम् इन् नु शरदो अन्ति देवास् \\ यत्रा नश् चक्रा जरसं तनूनाम् । \ पुत्रासो यत्र पितरो मदन्ति \ मा नो मध्या रीरिषतायुर् गन्तोः ।
15.5.1.f.m: “A hundred autumns indeed are before us, O gods, / where you have ordained old age for our bodies, / where sons become fathers; / do not cut short our life midway through its course.”

15.5.1.h.s: śrutkarṇāya kavaye medhyāya \ vacobhir nākam upayāmi śam̐san / \ yato bhayam abhayaṃ tat kṛdhī nas \\ agne devānām ava heḍa yukṣva /
15.5.1.h.d: श्रुत्कर्णाय कवये मेध्याय \ वचोभिर् नाकम् उपयामि शम्̐सन् । \ यतो भयम् अभयं तत् कृधी नस् \\ अग्ने देवानाम् अव हेड युक्ष्व ।
15.5.1.h.m: “To the attentive-eared, wise, sacrificial [Agni], / I approach heaven with words, praising [him]. / From whatever there is fear, make freedom from fear for us; / O Agni, appease the wrath of the gods.”

15.5.1.i.s: agniṃ vo devam agnibhiḥ sajoṣās \\ yaviṣṭhaṃ dūtam adhvare kṛṇudhvam / \ yo martyeṣu nidhruvir ṛtāvā \\ tapurmūrdhā ghṛtānnaḥ pāvakas \\ ghṛtapratīko ghṛtayonir agnir \ ghṛtaiḥ samiddho ghṛtam asyānnam / \ ghṛtapruṣas tvā sarito vananti \ ghṛtaṃ pibant suyajā yakṣi devān //
15.5.1.i.d: अग्निं वो देवम् अग्निभिः सजोषास् \\ यविष्ठं दूतम् अध्वरे कृणुध्वम् । \ यो मर्त्येषु निध्रुविर् ऋतावा \\ तपुर्मूर्धा घृतान्नः पावकस् \\ घृतप्रतीको घृतयोनिर् अग्निर् \ घृतैः समिद्धो घृतम् अस्यान्नम् । \ घृतप्रुषस् त्वा सरितो वनन्ति \ घृतं पिबन्त् सुयजा यक्षि देवान् ॥
15.5.1.i.m: “Agni your god, along with the fires, united, / make the youngest messenger at the sacrifice, / who is steadfast among mortals, keeper of truth, / blazing-headed, ghee-fed, purifying. / Agni whose face is ghee, whose womb is ghee, / enkindled with portions of ghee, ghee is his food. / Streams dripping with ghee delight in you; / drinking ghee, sacrifice well to the gods!”

15.5.1.j.s: āyurdā agne \\ imo agne \ sapta te agne \ mano jyotir juṣatām \\ trayastrim̐śat \\ yan me manasaś chidram \\ viśvakarmā \ yunajmi tvā \\ agniṃ yunajmi \\ indhānās tvā //
15.5.1.j.d: आयुर्दा अग्ने \\ इमो अग्ने \ सप्त ते अग्ने \ मनो ज्योतिर् जुषताम् \\ त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शत् \\ यन् मे मनसश् छिद्रम् \\ विश्वकर्मा \ युनज्मि त्वा \\ अग्निं युनज्मि \\ इन्धानास् त्वा ॥
15.5.1.j.m: “Giver of life-span, O Agni;” “These, O Agni;” “Seven are yours, O Agni;” “May the mind enjoy the light;” “Thirty-three;” “Whatever flaw of my mind;” “Viśvakarman;” “I yoke you;” “I yoke Agni;” “Enkindling you.”

15.5.1.k.s: agnir na īḍita īḍitavyair devaiḥ pārthivaiḥ pātu / \ vāyur na īḍita īḍitavyair devairāntarikṣaiḥ pātu \ sūryo na īḍita īḍitavyair devair divyaiḥ pātu / \ viṣṇur na īḍita īḍitavyair devair diśyaiḥ pātu / \ agnir yajurbhiḥ pūṣā svagākāreṇa ta imaṃ yajñam avantu te mām avantv anu va ārabhe 'nu mārabhadhvam̐ svāhā \\ ity etais tribhir anuvākair avijñātaprāyaścitte some trayastrim̐śatam āhutīr juhoti //
15.5.1.k.d: अग्निर् न ईडित ईडितव्यैर् देवैः पार्थिवैः पातु । \ वायुर् न ईडित ईडितव्यैर् देवैरान्तरिक्षैः पातु \ सूर्यो न ईडित ईडितव्यैर् देवैर् दिव्यैः पातु । \ विष्णुर् न ईडित ईडितव्यैर् देवैर् दिश्यैः पातु । \ अग्निर् यजुर्भिः पूषा स्वगाकारेण त इमं यज्ञम् अवन्तु ते माम् अवन्त्व् अनु व आरभे ऽनु मारभध्वम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इत्य् एतैस् त्रिभिर् अनुवाकैर् अविज्ञातप्रायश्चित्ते सोमे त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शतम् आहुतीर् जुहोति ॥
15.5.1.k.m: “May Agni, praised, protect us along with the praiseworthy earthly gods; / may Vāyu, praised, protect us along with the praiseworthy atmospheric gods; / may Sūrya, praised, protect us along with the praiseworthy heavenly gods; / may Viṣṇu, praised, protect us along with the praiseworthy gods of the quarters; / may Agni with the yajus formulas, Pūṣan with the exclamation svagā, protect this sacrifice; may they protect me; I take hold after you, do take hold after me, svāhā!” With these three anuvākas he offers thirty-three oblations at an unknown expiation in a soma sacrifice.

15.5.2.a.m: Thirty-three [oblations called] “Forms of Sacrifice” in the āgnīdhra fire.

15.5.3.a.s: pṛthivi bhūvari sinīvāly urandhra ācitte manas te bhuvo vivaste \\ iti vasatīvarīṣu savanīyāsu vā viṣiktāsu saptāhutīr juhoti //
15.5.3.a.d: पृथिवि भूवरि सिनीवाल्य् उरन्ध्र आचित्ते मनस् ते भुवो विवस्ते \\ इति वसतीवरीषु सवनीयासु वा विषिक्तासु सप्ताहुतीर् जुहोति ॥
15.5.3.a.m: With: “Earth, abundance, Sinīvālī, broad-jointed, into the thought your mind, may you become bright,” he offers seven oblations when the vasatīvarī waters or the savanīyā waters have spilled.

15.5.4.a.s: somasyājyam asi haviṣo havir jyotiṣāṃ jyotir \ viśveṣām devānāṃ bhāgadheyī stha \\ ity abhimantrya saṃ vaḥ siñcantu marutaḥ \ sam indraḥ saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ / \ saṃ vo 'yam agniḥ siñcatu \\ āyuṣā ca balena ca / \ sarvam āyur dadhātu me // \ māndā vāśāḥ / \ āpo bhadrāḥ / \ ād it paśyāmi / \ āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvas \\ yo vaḥ śivatamo rasas \ tasmā araṃ gamāma vas \\ ity etābhiḥ saptabhiḥ sam̐siñced abhi vā mantrayet //
15.5.4.a.d: सोमस्याज्यम् असि हविषो हविर् ज्योतिषां ज्योतिर् \ विश्वेषाम् देवानां भागधेयी स्थ \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य सं वः सिञ्चन्तु मरुतः \ सम् इन्द्रः सं बृहस्पतिः । \ सं वो ऽयम् अग्निः सिञ्चतु \\ आयुषा च बलेन च । \ सर्वम् आयुर् दधातु मे ॥ \ मान्दा वाशाः । \ आपो भद्राः । \ आद् इत् पश्यामि । \ आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस् \\ यो वः शिवतमो रसस् \ तस्मा अरं गमाम वस् \\ इत्य् एताभिः सप्तभिः सम्̐सिञ्चेद् अभि वा मन्त्रयेत् ॥
15.5.4.a.m: Consecrating with: “You are the clarified butter of soma, the sacrificial oblation of sacrificial oblations, the light of lights; you are the shares of all the gods,” he should pour together or consecrate with these seven [verses]: “May the Maruts sprinkle for you, / may Indra, may Bṛhaspati; / may this Agni sprinkle for you / with life-span and with strength; / may he grant me full life-span!” “Māndā vāśāḥ;” “The waters are auspicious;” “Then indeed I see;” “Waters, you are indeed refreshing;” “Whatever is your most auspicious sap;” “To that we would gladly go for you.”

15.5.5.a.s: yadi prātaḥsavane purā homāt somo 'tiricyeta taṃ camaseṣv abhyunnayeyur upajuhuyur vā //
15.5.5.a.d: यदि प्रातःसवने पुरा होमात् सोमो ऽतिरिच्येत तं चमसेष्व् अभ्युन्नयेयुर् उपजुहुयुर् वा ॥
15.5.5.a.m: If at the morning pressing before the offering soma should be left over, they should draw it up into the cups or offer it additionally.

15.5.6.a.d: हुते ऽतिरिक्तस्याशयित्वा स्तुतशस्त्रवन्तं कुर्युः सा प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
15.5.6.a.m: When it has been offered, having caused [the priests] to consume the surplus, they should perform [a chant and recitation] provided with a stotra and a śastra; that is the expiation.

15.5.7.a.s: hotṛcamasamukhyām̐ś camasān unnīya bṛhataḥ stotram upākaroti //
15.5.7.a.d: होतृचमसमुख्याम्̐श् चमसान् उन्नीय बृहतः स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति ॥
15.5.7.a.m: Having drawn the cups beginning with the hotṛ’s cup, he introduces the stotra of the Bṛhat [sāman].

15.5.8.a.s: gaur dhayati marutām iti dhayadvatīṣu stuvīran //
15.5.8.a.d: गौर् धयति मरुताम् इति धयद्वतीषु स्तुवीरन् ॥
15.5.8.a.m: They should chant upon the verses containing “suckles”: “The cow suckles of the Maruts.”

15.5.9.a.s: asti somo ayam̐ sutas iti vaitāsv aindrāvaiṣṇavībhir hotre stuyuḥ //
15.5.9.a.d: अस्ति सोमो अयम्̐ सुतस् इति वैतास्व् ऐन्द्रावैष्णवीभिर् होत्रे स्तुयुः ॥
15.5.9.a.m: Or on: “There is this pressed soma,” they should chant for the hotṛ with verses addressed to Indra and Viṣṇu.

15.5.10.a.m: The hotṛ recites [a śastra] addressed to Indra and Viṣṇu.

15.5.11.a.d: एतद् एव माध्यंदिने सवने ऽतिरिक्ते प्रायश्चित्तम् ॥
15.5.11.a.m: This very same is the expiation when there is a surplus at the midday pressing.

15.5.12.a.s: baṇ mahām̐ asi sūrya \\ iti sauryeṣu bṛhatā gauravītena vā stuvīran / etad eva tṛtīyasavane 'tirikte prāyaścittam / vaiṣṇavīṣu śipiviṣṭavatīṣu bṛhatā gauravītena vā stuvīran //
15.5.12.a.d: बण् महाम्̐ असि सूर्य \\ इति सौर्येषु बृहता गौरवीतेन वा स्तुवीरन् । एतद् एव तृतीयसवने ऽतिरिक्ते प्रायश्चित्तम् । वैष्णवीषु शिपिविष्टवतीषु बृहता गौरवीतेन वा स्तुवीरन् ॥
15.5.12.a.m: They should chant with the Bṛhat or Gauravīta on verses addressed to Sūrya: “Truly great are you, O Sūrya.” This very same is the expiation when there is a surplus at the third pressing. They should chant with the Bṛhat or Gauravīta on verses addressed to Viṣṇu containing “Śipiviṣṭa”.

15.5.13.a.m: If soma is left over at an Agniṣṭoma, he should make it an Ukthya.

15.5.14.a.s: yad ukthye ṣoḍaśinaṃ yadi ṣoḍaśiny atirātraṃ yady atiratre / ( dvirātraṃ yadi dvirātra ekastotram eva ) //
15.5.14.a.d: यद् उक्थ्ये षोडशिनं यदि षोडशिन्य् अतिरात्रं यद्य् अतिरत्रे । ( द्विरात्रं यदि द्विरात्र एकस्तोत्रम् एव ) ॥
15.5.14.a.m: If at an Ukthya, a Ṣoḍaśin; if at a Ṣoḍaśin, an Atirātra; if at an Atirātra, a Dvirātra; if at a Dvirātra, only an additional stotra.

15.5.15.a.s: ( tatra ) vaiṣṇavīṣu śipiviṣṭavatīṣu bṛhatā gauravītena vā stuvīran //
15.5.15.a.d: ( तत्र ) वैष्णवीषु शिपिविष्टवतीषु बृहता गौरवीतेन वा स्तुवीरन् ॥
15.5.15.a.m: There, they should chant with the Bṛhat or Gauravīta on verses addressed to Viṣṇu containing “Śipiviṣṭa”.

15.5.16.a.s: yadi somau sam̐sutau syātāṃ prathamāni catvāri saṃbhārayajūm̐ṣi hutvā mahati rātriyai prātaranuvākam upākuryāt / tasmin parihite \\ ehi yajamāna \\ ity ukte 'nvārabdhe yajamāne saṃveśāyopaveśāya gāyatriyā abhibhūtyai svāhā \\ iti purastāt prātaḥsavanasya juhuyāt //
15.5.16.a.d: यदि सोमौ सम्̐सुतौ स्यातां प्रथमानि चत्वारि संभारयजूम्̐षि हुत्वा महति रात्रियै प्रातरनुवाकम् उपाकुर्यात् । तस्मिन् परिहिते \\ एहि यजमान \\ इत्य् उक्ते ऽन्वारब्धे यजमाने संवेशायोपवेशाय गायत्रिया अभिभूत्यै स्वाहा \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रातःसवनस्य जुहुयात् ॥
15.5.16.a.m: If two somas should be pressed simultaneously, having offered the first four saṃbhāra-yajus formulas, he should introduce the morning litany while the night is still deep. When that is concluded, when “Come, O sacrificer” has been spoken, and while the sacrificer holds on from behind, he should offer before the morning pressing: “For entering, for sitting down, for the dominance of the Gāyatrī, svāhā!”

15.5.17.a.s: uttarāṇi catvāri saṃbhārayajūm̐ṣi hutvā saṃveśāyopaveśāya triṣṭubho 'bhibhūtyai svāhā \\ iti purastān mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya juhuyāt / uttarāṇi catvāri saṃbhārayajūm̐ṣi hutvā saṃveśāyopaveśāya jagatyā abhibhūtyai svāhā \\ iti purastāt tṛtīyasavanasya juhuyāt / uttarāṇi catvāri saṃbhārayajūm̐ṣi hutvā saṃveśāyopaveśāyānuṣṭubho 'bhibhūtyai svāhā \\ iti purastād anūbandhyāyā vapāyā juhuyāt / uttarāṇi catvāri saṃbhārayajūm̐ṣi hutvā saṃveśāyopaveśāya paṅktyā abhibhūtyai svāhā \\ iti purastād udavasānīyāyā juhuyāt / samiddhe 'gnau hūyante prāṇāpānau mṛtyor mā pātam \\ prāṇāpānau mā mā hāsiṣṭam iti dve āhutī //
15.5.17.a.d: उत्तराणि चत्वारि संभारयजूम्̐षि हुत्वा संवेशायोपवेशाय त्रिष्टुभो ऽभिभूत्यै स्वाहा \\ इति पुरस्तान् माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य जुहुयात् । उत्तराणि चत्वारि संभारयजूम्̐षि हुत्वा संवेशायोपवेशाय जगत्या अभिभूत्यै स्वाहा \\ इति पुरस्तात् तृतीयसवनस्य जुहुयात् । उत्तराणि चत्वारि संभारयजूम्̐षि हुत्वा संवेशायोपवेशायानुष्टुभो ऽभिभूत्यै स्वाहा \\ इति पुरस्ताद् अनूबन्ध्याया वपाया जुहुयात् । उत्तराणि चत्वारि संभारयजूम्̐षि हुत्वा संवेशायोपवेशाय पङ्क्त्या अभिभूत्यै स्वाहा \\ इति पुरस्ताद् उदवसानीयाया जुहुयात् । समिद्धे ऽग्नौ हूयन्ते प्राणापानौ मृत्योर् मा पातम् \\ प्राणापानौ मा मा हासिष्टम् इति द्वे आहुती ॥
15.5.17.a.m: Having offered the next four Saṃbhāra formulas, he should offer before the midday pressing with: 'To entering, to sitting down, to the overcoming power of the Triṣṭubh, svāhā!' Having offered the next four Saṃbhāra formulas, he should offer before the third pressing with: 'To entering, to sitting down, to the overcoming power of the Jagatī, svāhā!' Having offered the next four Saṃbhāra formulas, he should offer before the omentum of the concluding animal sacrifice with: 'To entering, to sitting down, to the overcoming power of the Anuṣṭubh, svāhā!' Having offered the next four Saṃbhāra formulas, he should offer before the Udavasānīyā rite with: 'To entering, to sitting down, to the overcoming power of the Paṅkti, svāhā!' In the kindled fire two oblations are offered: 'O in-breath and out-breath, protect me from death! / O in-breath and out-breath, do not abandon me!'

15.5.18.a.s: purastāt pāśukāt sviṣṭakṛto juhoty etivatīḥ pratipado bhavanti / pretivanty ājyāni /
15.5.18.a.d: पुरस्तात् पाशुकात् स्विष्टकृतो जुहोत्य् एतिवतीः प्रतिपदो भवन्ति । प्रेतिवन्त्य् आज्यानि ।
15.5.18.a.m: Before the animal Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers. The opening verses contain the word eti. The clarified butter portions contain the word preti.

15.5.19.a.m: Or the opening verses contain the words marutvat or pūṣanvat.

15.5.20.a.s: yady agniṣṭomaḥ somaḥ parastāt syād ukthyaṃ kurvīta / yady ukthyaḥ ṣoḍaśinam / yadi ṣoḍaśy atirātram / yady atirātro 'ptoryāmam / yady aptoryāmo dvirātram / yadi dvirātras trirātram / yadi trirātra ekastotram eva //
15.5.20.a.d: यद्य् अग्निष्टोमः सोमः परस्तात् स्याद् उक्थ्यं कुर्वीत । यद्य् उक्थ्यः षोडशिनम् । यदि षोडश्य् अतिरात्रम् । यद्य् अतिरात्रो ऽप्तोर्यामम् । यद्य् अप्तोर्यामो द्विरात्रम् । यदि द्विरात्रस् त्रिरात्रम् । यदि त्रिरात्र एकस्तोत्रम् एव ॥
15.5.20.a.m: If the [competing] Soma sacrifice is an Agniṣṭoma, he should perform an Ukthya; if an Ukthya, a Ṣoḍaśin; if a Ṣoḍaśin, an Atirātra; if an Atirātra, an Aptoryāma; if an Aptoryāma, a Dvirātra; if a Dvirātra, a Trirātra; if a Trirātra, [he should perform] just an Ekastotra.

15.5.21.a.s: abhijit kāryo 'bhijityai / viśvajit kāryo viśvasya jityai / sarvastomaḥ sarvapṛṣṭhaḥ sarvasyāptyai sarvasyāvaruddhyai / krośānukrośe kārye vasiṣṭhasya nihave ubhe bṛhadrathaṃtare kārye / sajanīyam̐ śasyaṃ vihavyam̐ śasyam agastyasya kayā śubhīyam̐ śasyam indrasya niṣkevalyaṃ tāni śam̐sed abhivartaṃ brahmasāma kuryāt / abhijitaṃ viśvajitaṃ vā yajñakratuṃ kuryād iti saṃpreṣyati //
15.5.21.a.d: अभिजित् कार्यो ऽभिजित्यै । विश्वजित् कार्यो विश्वस्य जित्यै । सर्वस्तोमः सर्वपृष्ठः सर्वस्याप्त्यै सर्वस्यावरुद्ध्यै । क्रोशानुक्रोशे कार्ये वसिष्ठस्य निहवे उभे बृहद्रथंतरे कार्ये । सजनीयम्̐ शस्यं विहव्यम्̐ शस्यम् अगस्त्यस्य कया शुभीयम्̐ शस्यम् इन्द्रस्य निष्केवल्यं तानि शम्̐सेद् अभिवर्तं ब्रह्मसाम कुर्यात् । अभिजितं विश्वजितं वा यज्ञक्रतुं कुर्याद् इति संप्रेष्यति ॥
15.5.21.a.m: An Abhijit should be performed for complete conquest; a Viśvajit should be performed for conquering all; [a sacrifice with] all stomas and all pṛṣṭhas for the attainment of all and the securing of all. The Krośa and Anukrośa [sāmans] should be used in the nihava of Vasiṣṭha; both Bṛhat and Rathaṃtara should be used. He should chant the Sajanīya hymn, the Vihavya hymn, and Agastya's Kayāśubhīya hymn as the Niṣkevalya hymn for Indra; he should make the Abhivarta the sāman for the brahman priest. 'He should perform an Abhijit or a Viśvajit sacrifice,' thus he directs.

15.5.22.a.s: pūrvavat sam̐sthāpyaḥ / abhiṣutyaṃ vā dakṣiṇābhir vā varṣīyām̐sam yajñakratuṃ kuryuḥ //
15.5.22.a.d: पूर्ववत् सम्̐स्थाप्यः । अभिषुत्यं वा दक्षिणाभिर् वा वर्षीयाम्̐सम् यज्ञक्रतुं कुर्युः ॥
15.5.22.a.m: It is to be concluded as before; or they should make the sacrifice greater by pressing soma [first] or by sacrificial gifts.

15.5.23.a.s: yāvad rathān hy antarā giriṃ bhidvā nadī tāvatā sam̐savaḥ samānajanapade sam̐savo nānājanapade sam̐savo nāvidviṣāṇyoḥ sam̐savo vidyata ity ekeṣām //
15.5.23.a.d: यावद् रथान् ह्य् अन्तरा गिरिं भिद्वा नदी तावता सम्̐सवः समानजनपदे सम्̐सवो नानाजनपदे सम्̐सवो नाविद्विषाण्योः सम्̐सवो विद्यत इत्य् एकेषाम् ॥
15.5.23.a.m: According to some, a competing pressing occurs as long as chariots [can pass] between, or a river dividing a mountain; a competing pressing occurs within the same region, [or] a competing pressing occurs in different regions; but no competing pressing exists between two who do not hate each other.

15.5.24.a.s: yadi dīkṣitānām upatāpaḥ syān mahān āgnīdhrīyam upasamādhāya brāhmaṇaṃ dakṣiṇato niṣādyaikavim̐śatiyavān darbhapuñjīlām̐ś ca pūrṇapātre 'vadhāya brāhmaṇāya procyāpaḥ paribrūyāt --- jīvā nāma stha tā imam amuṃ jīvayata \ jīvikā nāma stha tā imam amuṃ jīvayata \ saṃjīvā nāma stha tā imam amum̐ saṃjīvayata \\ iti praibrūyāt //
15.5.24.a.d: यदि दीक्षितानाम् उपतापः स्यान् महान् आग्नीध्रीयम् उपसमाधाय ब्राह्मणं दक्षिणतो निषाद्यैकविम्̐शतियवान् दर्भपुञ्जीलाम्̐श् च पूर्णपात्रे ऽवधाय ब्राह्मणाय प्रोच्यापः परिब्रूयात् --- जीवा नाम स्थ ता इमम् अमुं जीवयत \ जीविका नाम स्थ ता इमम् अमुं जीवयत \ संजीवा नाम स्थ ता इमम् अमुम्̐ संजीवयत \\ इति प्रैब्रूयात् ॥
15.5.24.a.m: If a severe illness should befall the consecrated sacrificers, having added fuel to the Āgnīdhra fire and seated a brāhmaṇa to the south, he places twenty-one barley grains and clumps of darbha grass into a full vessel, and having announced it to the brāhmaṇa, he addresses the waters: 'You are living by name; cause this N.N. to live. You are livelihood by name; cause this N.N. to live. You are full-living by name; cause this N.N. to live fully.' Thus he addresses [them].

15.5.25.a.s: yā jātā oṣadhayas \\ ity oṣadhisūktenaitābhir adbhir abhiṣiñcet //
15.5.25.a.d: या जाता ओषधयस् \\ इत्य् ओषधिसूक्तेनैताभिर् अद्भिर् अभिषिञ्चेत् ॥
15.5.25.a.m: He should sprinkle him with these waters with the hymn to the plants: 'Those that are born, the plants…'

15.5.26.a.s: pāyayaty etāsām apāṃ prāṇāpānau ta upām̐svantaryāmau pātām asau \ vyānaṃ ta upām̐śusavanaḥ pātu \ vācaṃ ma aindravāyavaḥ pātu \ dakṣakratū te maitrāvaruṇaḥ pātu \ cakṣuṣī te śukrāmanthinau pātām \\ śrotraṃ ta āśvinaḥ pātu \\ ātmānaṃ ta āgrayaṇaḥ pātu \\ aṅgāni ma ukthyaḥ pātu \\ āyuṣ ṭe dhruvaḥ pātu \ vīryaṃ te 'tigrāhyāḥ pāntv asau \\ ity abhimṛśati //
15.5.26.a.d: पाययत्य् एतासाम् अपां प्राणापानौ त उपाम्̐स्वन्तर्यामौ पाताम् असौ \ व्यानं त उपाम्̐शुसवनः पातु \ वाचं म ऐन्द्रवायवः पातु \ दक्षक्रतू ते मैत्रावरुणः पातु \ चक्षुषी ते शुक्रामन्थिनौ पाताम् \\ श्रोत्रं त आश्विनः पातु \\ आत्मानं त आग्रयणः पातु \\ अङ्गानि म उक्थ्यः पातु \\ आयुष् टे ध्रुवः पातु \ वीर्यं ते ऽतिग्राह्याः पान्त्व् असौ \\ इत्य् अभिमृशति ॥
15.5.26.a.m: He makes him drink of these waters. He touches him with: 'May the Upāṃśu and Antaryāma [cups] protect your in-breath and out-breath, N.N.! May the Upāṃśusavana protect your diffused breath! May the Aindravāyava protect my speech! May the Maitrāvaruṇa protect your skill and resolve! May the Śukra and Manthin protect your eyes! May the Āśvina protect your hearing! May the Āgrayaṇa protect your self! May the Ukthya protect my limbs! May the Dhruva protect your lifespan! May the Atigrāhyas protect your vigor, N.N.!'

15.5.27.a.s: pratijapati prāṇāpānau ma upām̐śvantaryāmau pātām \\ vyānaṃ me upām̐śusavanaḥ pātu \ vācaṃ ma aindravāyavaḥ pātu \ dakṣakratū me maitrāvaruṇaḥ pātu \ cakṣuṣī me śukrāmanthinau pātām \\ śrotraṃ ma āśvinaḥ pātu \\ ātmānaṃ ma āgrayaṇaḥ pātu \\ aṅgāni ma ukthyaḥ pātu \ vāyur me dhruvaḥ pātu \ vīryaṃ me 'tigrāhyāḥ pāntu \\ iti pratijapite puṣṭipatau puṣṭiṃ prāṇe prāṇam apāne 'pānaṃ vyāne vyānam udāna udānam̐ samāne samānaṃ vāci vācam asmai punar dhehi \\ ity āhutiṃ juhoti //
15.5.27.a.d: प्रतिजपति प्राणापानौ म उपाम्̐श्वन्तर्यामौ पाताम् \\ व्यानं मे उपाम्̐शुसवनः पातु \ वाचं म ऐन्द्रवायवः पातु \ दक्षक्रतू मे मैत्रावरुणः पातु \ चक्षुषी मे शुक्रामन्थिनौ पाताम् \\ श्रोत्रं म आश्विनः पातु \\ आत्मानं म आग्रयणः पातु \\ अङ्गानि म उक्थ्यः पातु \ वायुर् मे ध्रुवः पातु \ वीर्यं मे ऽतिग्राह्याः पान्तु \\ इति प्रतिजपिते पुष्टिपतौ पुष्टिं प्राणे प्राणम् अपाने ऽपानं व्याने व्यानम् उदान उदानम्̐ समाने समानं वाचि वाचम् अस्मै पुनर् धेहि \\ इत्य् आहुतिं जुहोति ॥
15.5.27.a.m: He whispers in response: 'May the Upāṃśu and Antaryāma protect my in-breath and out-breath! May the Upāṃśusavana protect my diffused breath! May the Aindravāyava protect my speech! May the Maitrāvaruṇa protect my skill and resolve! May the Śukra and Manthin protect my eyes! May the Āśvina protect my hearing! May the Āgrayaṇa protect my self! May the Ukthya protect my limbs! May Vāyu as Dhruva protect me! May the Atigrāhyas protect my vigor!' When he has whispered in response, he offers an oblation with: 'O Lord of nourishment, restore in him nourishment in the lord of nourishment, in-breath in in-breath, out-breath in out-breath, diffused breath in diffused breath, upward breath in upward breath, middle breath in middle breath, speech in speech!'

15.5.28.a.m: He does not perform the healing rite again.

15.5.29.a.s: yadi mriyeta prāg avabhṛthād agnyavabhṛthaṃ kuryuḥ //
15.5.29.a.d: यदि म्रियेत प्राग् अवभृथाद् अग्न्यवभृथं कुर्युः ॥
15.5.29.a.m: If he should die before the purificatory bath, they should perform a purificatory bath by fire.

15.5.30.a.s: avabhṛthaṃ vā gamayitvodāhṛtyāvabhṛthād agnibhir abhisamāhāraṃ daheyuḥ //
15.5.30.a.d: अवभृथं वा गमयित्वोदाहृत्यावभृथाद् अग्निभिर् अभिसमाहारं दहेयुः ॥
15.5.30.a.m: Or having brought him to the purificatory bath and taken him out of the purificatory bath, they should cremate him by gathering the fires together.

15.5.32.a.s: ahargaṇe tu \\ āhara daha \\ ity uktvā dakṣiṇāgner aṅgāraṃ nirvartya nirmanthyena vā daheyuḥ //
15.5.32.a.d: अहर्गणे तु \\ आहर दह \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा दक्षिणाग्नेर् अङ्गारं निर्वर्त्य निर्मन्थ्येन वा दहेयुः ॥
15.5.32.a.m: In a sacrificial session of multiple days, however, having said, 'Bring [the fire], cremate,' they should cremate him after taking out an ember from the dakṣiṇāgni, or with fire produced by churning.

15.5.33.a.m: He deposits the bone jar on the southern hip of the altar.

15.5.34.a.m: The udgātṛs should chant with the three Sārparājñī verses, adapted [as a stoma].

15.5.35.a.s: itara ṛtvijo hotṛprathamāḥ prācīnāvītino yāmīr anubruvantaḥ sārparājñīnāṃ kīrtayanto dakṣiṇān keśapakṣān udgrathya savyān prasrasya dakṣiṇān ūrūn āghnānāḥ savyān ity ekeṣām //
15.5.35.a.d: इतर ऋत्विजो होतृप्रथमाः प्राचीनावीतिनो यामीर् अनुब्रुवन्तः सार्पराज्ञीनां कीर्तयन्तो दक्षिणान् केशपक्षान् उद्ग्रथ्य सव्यान् प्रस्रस्य दक्षिणान् ऊरून् आघ्नानाः सव्यान् इत्य् एकेषाम् ॥
15.5.35.a.m: The other priests, led by the hotṛ, wearing the sacred cord over the right shoulder, reciting verses to Yama, proclaiming the Sārparājñī verses, having tied up their right locks of hair and loosened their left, beating their right thighs—their left, according to some—

15.5.36.a.m: should walk around the Mārjālīya three times counter-clockwise.

15.5.37.a.s: aindravāyavāgrā grahā maitrāvaruṇāgrā vā mārjālīyanyante bhakṣān upaninīyuḥ //
15.5.37.a.d: ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रा ग्रहा मैत्रावरुणाग्रा वा मार्जालीयन्यन्ते भक्षान् उपनिनीयुः ॥
15.5.37.a.m: The cups having the Aindravāyava first, or having the Maitrāvaruṇa first, they should pour down the portions of soma near the Mārjālīya.

15.5.38.a.s: agna āyūm̐ṣi pavase \\ iti pratipadaṃ kurvīran //
15.5.38.a.d: अग्न आयूम्̐षि पवसे \\ इति प्रतिपदं कुर्वीरन् ॥
15.5.38.a.m: They should make the opening verse with: 'Agni, you purify lifespans…'

15.5.39.a.s: etāvad anāthe nāthavatas tu dagdhvāsthīny upanahya yas tasya svo nediṣṭhī syāt taṃ tasya sthāne dīkṣayitvā tena saha yajeran //
15.5.39.a.d: एतावद् अनाथे नाथवतस् तु दग्ध्वास्थीन्य् उपनह्य यस् तस्य स्वो नेदिष्ठी स्यात् तं तस्य स्थाने दीक्षयित्वा तेन सह यजेरन् ॥
15.5.39.a.m: This much for one without a protector. But for one with a protector, having cremated him and wrapped the bones, having consecrated in his place whoever is his nearest relative, they should sacrifice along with him.

15.5.40.a.s: saṃvatsare 'sthīni yājayeyuḥ / agniṣṭomaḥ somo rathaṃtaraṃ gauravītaṃ vā sāma saptadaśaḥ stomo vyākhyāte grahāgre stotre 'sthikumbham upanidadhāti //
15.5.40.a.d: संवत्सरे ऽस्थीनि याजयेयुः । अग्निष्टोमः सोमो रथंतरं गौरवीतं वा साम सप्तदशः स्तोमो व्याख्याते ग्रहाग्रे स्तोत्रे ऽस्थिकुम्भम् उपनिदधाति ॥
15.5.40.a.m: After a year, they should perform a sacrifice over the bones: an Agniṣṭoma Soma sacrifice, the Rathaṃtara or Gauravīta sāman, a seventeen-fold stoma. He places the bone jar near the chant during the explained cup-beginning [rite].

15.5.41.a.m: They chant with the Yama sāman. The sacrificial gift is one hundred and twelve [cows].

15.6.1.a.s: yadi satrāya dīkṣetāthāsya sāmyutthānaṃ jāyeta / somam apabhajya viśvajitātirātreṇa sarvastomena sarvapṛṣṭhena sarvavesasadakṣiṇena yajeta //
15.6.1.a.d: यदि सत्राय दीक्षेताथास्य साम्युत्थानं जायेत । सोमम् अपभज्य विश्वजितातिरात्रेण सर्वस्तोमेन सर्वपृष्ठेन सर्ववेससदक्षिणेन यजेत ॥
15.6.1.a.m: If he should be consecrated for a sacrificial session and then his leaving mid-rite occurs: having apportioned the soma, he should sacrifice with a Viśvajit Atirātra with all stomas, all pṛṣṭhas, and with his entire property as sacrificial gift.

15.6.2.a.m: He undertakes the rites from the point where they were completed.

15.6.3.a.s: avalikhyokhāyās tair anyāṃ mṛdam̐ sam̐skṛtya kuryāt //
15.6.3.a.d: अवलिख्योखायास् तैर् अन्यां मृदम्̐ सम्̐स्कृत्य कुर्यात् ॥
15.6.3.a.m: Having scraped off [clay] from the cauldron, having prepared other clay with those [scrapings], he should fashion [another cauldron].

15.6.4.a.m: Having scraped off [clay] from the animal heads, he should attach it silently [to the replacements].

15.6.5.a.m: When the āhavanīya fire has been carried forward, he carries the fire silently.

15.6.6.a.d: संचिते ऽग्नाव् उत्तिष्ठतो न साम्युत्थाने ऽग्निचयनं विद्यते ॥
15.6.6.a.m: When one rises while the fire altar has been piled, there is no piling of the fire altar in the leaving mid-rite.

15.6.7.a.s: prācīnam udīcīnaṃ vodavasāya vihāram̐ sādhayitvā sarvapṛṣṭyā yajeta / sarvakratubhya āgūryāśakyamāne yaṣṭum / traidhātavīyayā satre tu viśvajitātirātreṇa //
15.6.7.a.d: प्राचीनम् उदीचीनं वोदवसाय विहारम्̐ साधयित्वा सर्वपृष्ट्या यजेत । सर्वक्रतुभ्य आगूर्याशक्यमाने यष्टुम् । त्रैधातवीयया सत्रे तु विश्वजितातिरात्रेण ॥
15.6.7.a.m: Having moved away to the east or north and established a sacrificial area, he should sacrifice with a Sarvapṛṣṭhā [iṣṭi]; when he has undertaken [to sacrifice] for all sacrifices, but is unable to sacrifice, with a Traidhātavīyā [iṣṭi]; but in a sacrificial session, with a Viśvajit Atirātra.

15.6.8.a.s: yadi sunvatām āhavanīyo 'nugacched āgnīdhrāt praṇayeyur enaṃ yady āgnīdhro gārhapatyād yadi gārhapatyo mantheyur enam //
15.6.8.a.d: यदि सुन्वताम् आहवनीयो ऽनुगच्छेद् आग्नीध्रात् प्रणयेयुर् एनं यद्य् आग्नीध्रो गार्हपत्याद् यदि गार्हपत्यो मन्थेयुर् एनम् ॥
15.6.8.a.m: If the āhavanīya fire of those who are pressing soma goes out, they should lead it forward from the Āgnīdhra fire; if the Āgnīdhra fire [goes out], from the gārhapatya; if the gārhapatya, they should churn it out.

15.6.9.a.m: From whatever wood it may go out, one should make fire-churning sticks of it.

15.6.11.a.s: brahmaṇa udgātre hotre 'dhvaryave ca caturo varān dadyāt //
15.6.11.a.d: ब्रह्मण उद्गात्रे होत्रे ऽध्वर्यवे च चतुरो वरान् दद्यात् ॥
15.6.11.a.m: He should give four choice gifts: to the brahman priest, to the udgātṛ, to the hotṛ, and to the adhvaryu.

15.6.12.a.s: yady akrītam̐ somam apahareyur anyaḥ kreyuḥ //
15.6.12.a.d: यद्य् अक्रीतम्̐ सोमम् अपहरेयुर् अन्यः क्रेयुः ॥
15.6.12.a.m: If they should steal the soma before it has been purchased, other [soma] should be bought.

15.6.13.a.s: yadi krītaṃ yo nediṣṭhī syāt tata āhṛtyābhiṣuṇuyāt //
15.6.13.a.d: यदि क्रीतं यो नेदिष्ठी स्यात् तत आहृत्याभिषुणुयात् ॥
15.6.13.a.m: If it has been purchased, he should fetch it from whoever may be nearest and press it.

15.6.14.a.m: He should give something to the soma-fetcher or to the soma-seller.

15.6.15.a.s: yadi taṃ na vindeyuḥ pūtīkān abhiṣuṇuyāt / yadi na pūtīkān atha phālgunāni / yadi na phālgunāny athārjunāny athādārān / yadi nādārānyā eva kāścārdrā oṣadhīr āhṛtyābhiṣuṇuyāt //
15.6.15.a.d: यदि तं न विन्देयुः पूतीकान् अभिषुणुयात् । यदि न पूतीकान् अथ फाल्गुनानि । यदि न फाल्गुनान्य् अथार्जुनान्य् अथादारान् । यदि नादारान्या एव काश्चार्द्रा ओषधीर् आहृत्याभिषुणुयात् ॥
15.6.15.a.m: If they do not find that, he should press pūtīka plants; if not pūtīka plants, then phālguna plants; if not phālguna plants, then arjuna plants, then ādāra plants; if not ādāra plants, he should bring whatever fresh herbs there are and press them.

15.6.16.a.s: pratidhuk prātaḥsavane pūtīkām̐ś ca / dadhi ca mādhyaṃdine savane pūtīkām̐ś ca / śṛtaṃ ca tṛtīyasavane pūtīkām̐ś ca //
15.6.16.a.d: प्रतिधुक् प्रातःसवने पूतीकाम्̐श् च । दधि च माध्यंदिने सवने पूतीकाम्̐श् च । शृतं च तृतीयसवने पूतीकाम्̐श् च ॥
15.6.16.a.m: Freshly milked milk and pūtīka plants at the morning pressing; curd and pūtīka plants at the midday pressing; and boiled milk and pūtīka plants at the third pressing.

15.6.17.a.s: apivā pratidhuṣā prātaḥsavane sarvān somāc chrīṇāti / śṛtena mādhyaṃdine savane dadhnā tṛtīyasavane nītamiśreṇa //
15.6.17.a.d: अपिवा प्रतिधुषा प्रातःसवने सर्वान् सोमाच् छ्रीणाति । शृतेन माध्यंदिने सवने दध्ना तृतीयसवने नीतमिश्रेण ॥
15.6.17.a.m: Or rather, he mixes all the somas with freshly milked milk at the morning pressing, with boiled milk at the midday pressing, and with curd mixed with fresh milk at the third pressing.

15.6.18.a.m: The soma [sacrifice] should be an Agniṣṭoma having the Rathaṃtara as its sāman.

15.6.19.a.s: ekāṃ gāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt tebhya eva //
15.6.19.a.d: एकां गां दक्षिणां दद्यात् तेभ्य एव ॥
15.6.19.a.m: He should give a single cow as the sacrificial fee, only to them.

15.6.20.a.s: purā dvādaśyāḥ saṃvatsare vā / tasmā eva kratave punar dīkṣeta / tatra tad dadyāt pūrvasmin dāsyant syāt ta evainam ṛtvijo yājayeyuḥ //
15.6.20.a.d: पुरा द्वादश्याः संवत्सरे वा । तस्मा एव क्रतवे पुनर् दीक्षेत । तत्र तद् दद्यात् पूर्वस्मिन् दास्यन्त् स्यात् त एवैनम् ऋत्विजो याजयेयुः ॥
15.6.20.a.m: Before the twelfth [day] or within a year, he should consecrate himself again for that very sacrifice. There he should give what he was going to give at the former [sacrifice]; the very same officiating priests should conduct the sacrifice for him.

15.6.21.a.s: atha yadi sadohavirdhānāny abhidahyeran grahān adhvaryuḥ spāśayet / stotrāṇy udgātā / śastrāṇi hotā //
15.6.21.a.d: अथ यदि सदोहविर्धानान्य् अभिदह्येरन् ग्रहान् अध्वर्युः स्पाशयेत् । स्तोत्राण्य् उद्गाता । शस्त्राणि होता ॥
15.6.21.a.m: Now if the sadas and the havirdhāna sheds should burn down, the adhvaryu should point out the cups, the udgātṛ the stotras, and the hotṛ the śastras.

15.6.22.a.m: If the soma has not been burnt, they should proceed with the rite from the concluded point.

15.6.23.a.m: If it has been burnt, the expiation is that which [is prescribed] when it is stolen.

15.6.24.a.s: pañcātra gā dakṣiṇā dadāti / pañca varān ity ekeṣām //
15.6.24.a.d: पञ्चात्र गा दक्षिणा ददाति । पञ्च वरान् इत्य् एकेषाम् ॥
15.6.24.a.m: Here he gives five cows as sacrificial fees; 'five choice gifts', according to some.

15.6.25.a.s: yadi grāvā dīryeta dyutānasya mārutasya sāmnā stuvīran / brahmasāmnety ekeṣām //
15.6.25.a.d: यदि ग्रावा दीर्येत द्युतानस्य मारुतस्य साम्ना स्तुवीरन् । ब्रह्मसाम्नेत्य् एकेषाम् ॥
15.6.25.a.m: If a pressing stone should break, they should chant praise with the sāman of Dyutāna Māruta; 'with the Brahmasāman', according to some.

15.6.26.a.s: yadi prātaḥsavane kalaśo dīryeta vaiṣṇavīṣu śipiviṣṭavatīṣu stuvīran //
15.6.26.a.d: यदि प्रातःसवने कलशो दीर्येत वैष्णवीषु शिपिविष्टवतीषु स्तुवीरन् ॥
15.6.26.a.m: If a vat should break at the morning pressing, they should chant praise on verses addressed to Viṣṇu containing the word śipiviṣṭa.

15.6.27.a.s: yadi mādhyaṃdine dīryeta vaṣaṭkāranidhanam̐ sāma kuryuḥ / yadi tṛtīyasavana etad eva //
15.6.27.a.d: यदि माध्यंदिने दीर्येत वषट्कारनिधनम्̐ साम कुर्युः । यदि तृतीयसवन एतद् एव ॥
15.6.27.a.m: If it should break at the midday pressing, they should perform a sāman having the vaṣaṭ-call as its cadence; if at the third pressing, the very same.

15.6.28.a.s: yadi kalaśo dīryeta vaṣaṭkāranidhanaṃ brahmasāma kuryur ity ekeṣām / sarveṣām anavayavena śrūyate //
15.6.28.a.d: यदि कलशो दीर्येत वषट्कारनिधनं ब्रह्मसाम कुर्युर् इत्य् एकेषाम् । सर्वेषाम् अनवयवेन श्रूयते ॥
15.6.28.a.m: If a vat should break, they should make a Brahmasāman having the vaṣaṭ-call as its cadence, according to some; it is taught [in the Brāhmaṇa] with respect to all without distinction.

15.6.29.a.s: asave svāhā \ vasave svāha \ vibhuve svāhā \ vivasvate svāhā \ gaṇaśriyai svāhā \ malimlucāya svāha \ śūṣāya svāhā \\ iti saptāhutīr hutvā \\ indrasya graho 'sy agṛhīto grāhyo devānām \\ pūr asi taṃ tvā prapadye saha grahaiḥ saha paśubhiḥ sahartvigbhiḥ saha somyaiḥ saha sadasyaiḥ saha dākṣiṇeyaiḥ saha dakṣiṇābhiḥ saha yajñena saha yajñapatinā \ praviśāni saha yan me asti tena \\ ity abhimantrya //
15.6.29.a.d: असवे स्वाहा \ वसवे स्वाह \ विभुवे स्वाहा \ विवस्वते स्वाहा \ गणश्रियै स्वाहा \ मलिम्लुचाय स्वाह \ शूषाय स्वाहा \\ इति सप्ताहुतीर् हुत्वा \\ इन्द्रस्य ग्रहो ऽस्य् अगृहीतो ग्राह्यो देवानाम् \\ पूर् असि तं त्वा प्रपद्ये सह ग्रहैः सह पशुभिः सहर्त्विग्भिः सह सोम्यैः सह सदस्यैः सह दाक्षिणेयैः सह दक्षिणाभिः सह यज्ञेन सह यज्ञपतिना \ प्रविशानि सह यन् मे अस्ति तेन \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य ॥
15.6.29.a.m: Having offered seven oblations with: 'To breath, svāhā! To Vasu, svāhā! To the all-pervading, svāhā! To Vivasvat, svāhā! To the splendor of the host, svāhā! To the intercalary month, svāhā! To strength, svāhā!', and having addressed [the vessel] with: 'You are the cup of Indra, not seized, to be seized for the gods. You are a stronghold; I enter into you together with the cups, together with the beasts, together with the officiating priests, together with the soma-drinkers, together with those seated in the sadas, together with those worthy of gifts, together with the sacrificial fees, together with the sacrifice, together with the lord of the sacrifice; may I enter together with whatever is mine.'—

15.6.30.a.s: saveśāya tvā \\ upaveśāya tvā \\ ity anusavanaṃ dīrṇe juhoti //
15.6.30.a.d: सवेशाय त्वा \\ उपवेशाय त्वा \\ इत्य् अनुसवनं दीर्णे जुहोति ॥
15.6.30.a.m: With: 'To entering into you!', 'To sitting down into you!', he offers at each pressing when [a vessel] is broken.

15.6.31.a.s: yadi sarvaiḥ paryāyair astutam abhivyuccheta ṣaḍbhir hotre stuyuḥ / tisṛbhistisṛbhir itarebhyaḥ //
15.6.31.a.d: यदि सर्वैः पर्यायैर् अस्तुतम् अभिव्युच्छेत षड्भिर् होत्रे स्तुयुः । तिसृभिस्तिसृभिर् इतरेभ्यः ॥
15.6.31.a.m: If daybreak should dawn upon it without having chanted through all the rounds, they should chant for the hotṛ with six [verses], and with three each for the others.

15.6.32.a.s: yadi dvābhyāṃ paryāyabhyām astutam abhivyucched dhotre maitrāvaruṇāya cānyatarasya stuyuḥ / brāhmaṇāccham̐sine 'cchāvākāya cānyatarasya //
15.6.32.a.d: यदि द्वाभ्यां पर्यायभ्याम् अस्तुतम् अभिव्युच्छेद् धोत्रे मैत्रावरुणाय चान्यतरस्य स्तुयुः । ब्राह्मणाच्छम्̐सिने ऽच्छावाकाय चान्यतरस्य ॥
15.6.32.a.m: If daybreak should dawn upon it without having chanted through two rounds, they should chant for the hotṛ and Maitrāvaruṇa in one [round], and for the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin and Acchāvāka in the other.

15.6.33.a.s: yady ekena pañcadaśabhir hotre stuyuḥ / tisṛbhistirṣbhir itarebhyaḥ //
15.6.33.a.d: यद्य् एकेन पञ्चदशभिर् होत्रे स्तुयुः । तिसृभिस्तिर्ष्भिर् इतरेभ्यः ॥
15.6.33.a.m: If without one [round], they should chant for the hotṛ with fifteen [verses], and with three each for the others.

15.6.34.a.s: agne vivasvad uṣasas \\ ity āśvinasya pratipadaṃ kurvīran //
15.6.34.a.d: अग्ने विवस्वद् उषसस् \\ इत्य् आश्विनस्य प्रतिपदं कुर्वीरन् ॥
15.6.34.a.m: They should make 'O Agni, bright at the dawns...' the opening verse of the Āśvina [śastra].

15.6.35.a.s: yasyāśvine śasyamāne sūryo nodiyāt / sarvā api dāśatayyaḥ śam̐set / sauryaṃ paśuṃ bahurūpam upākuryāt / yasyāśvine śasyamāne sūryo nāvirbhavatīti vijñāyate //
15.6.35.a.d: यस्याश्विने शस्यमाने सूर्यो नोदियात् । सर्वा अपि दाशतय्यः शम्̐सेत् । सौर्यं पशुं बहुरूपम् उपाकुर्यात् । यस्याश्विने शस्यमाने सूर्यो नाविर्भवतीति विज्ञायते ॥
15.6.35.a.m: He during whose recitation of the Āśvina [śastra] the sun does not rise should recite all the ten collections [of the Ṛgveda]; he should dedicate a multicolored animal to Sūrya; for it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa]: 'He during whose recitation of the Āśvina [śastra] the sun does not appear.'

15.6.36.a.s: yadi samanvārabdhānām̐ sarpatām udgātāpacchidyeta / yajñena yajamāno vyṛdhyetādakṣiṇaḥ sa yajñakratuḥ sam̐sthāpyo 'thānya āhṛtyaḥ //
15.6.36.a.d: यदि समन्वारब्धानाम्̐ सर्पताम् उद्गातापच्छिद्येत । यज्ञेन यजमानो व्यृध्येतादक्षिणः स यज्ञक्रतुः सम्̐स्थाप्यो ऽथान्य आहृत्यः ॥
15.6.36.a.m: If the udgātṛ should break off while they are gliding in procession holding on to one another, the sacrificer would be deprived of the sacrifice; that sacrificial rite should be brought to completion without sacrificial fees, and then another [sacrifice] is to be undertaken.

15.6.37.a.s: tatra tad dadyād yat pūrvasmin dāsyan syāt //
15.6.37.a.d: तत्र तद् दद्याद् यत् पूर्वस्मिन् दास्यन् स्यात् ॥
15.6.37.a.m: There he should give what he was going to give at the former [sacrifice].

15.6.38.a.s: ta evainam ṛtvijo yājayeyuḥ / atha yadi prastotāpacchidyeta yajñasya śiro 'pacchidyeta brahmaṇe varaṃ dattvā //
15.6.38.a.d: त एवैनम् ऋत्विजो याजयेयुः । अथ यदि प्रस्तोतापच्छिद्येत यज्ञस्य शिरो ऽपच्छिद्येत ब्रह्मणे वरं दत्त्वा ॥
15.6.38.a.m: The very same officiating priests should conduct the sacrifice for him. Now if the prastotṛ should break off, the head of the sacrifice would be broken off; having given a choice gift to the brahman priest,

15.6.40.a.s: atha yadi pratihartāpacchidyeta paśubhir yajamāno vyṛdhyeta / punar yajñe sarvavedasaṃ dadyāt //
15.6.40.a.d: अथ यदि प्रतिहर्तापच्छिद्येत पशुभिर् यजमानो व्यृध्येत । पुनर् यज्ञे सर्ववेदसं दद्यात् ॥
15.6.40.a.m: Now if the pratihartṛ should break off, the sacrificer would be deprived of cattle; at the renewed sacrifice he should give his entire property.

15.6.41.a.s: yugapadapacchinnayor udgātuḥ prāyaścittaṃ kuryāt / pratihartuḥ sarvaprāyaścittaṃ juhuyāt //
15.6.41.a.d: युगपदपच्छिन्नयोर् उद्गातुः प्रायश्चित्तं कुर्यात् । प्रतिहर्तुः सर्वप्रायश्चित्तं जुहुयात् ॥
15.6.41.a.m: If two should break off simultaneously, he should perform the expiation for the udgātṛ; he should offer the all-expiation for the pratihartṛ.

15.6.42.a.m: In the case of a break-off occurring earlier and later, whichever is later, [for that] he should perform the all-expiation.

15.6.43.a.s: yady udgātā jaghnyo 'pacchidyeta punar yajñe sarvavedasaṃ dadyāt //
15.6.43.a.d: यद्य् उद्गाता जघ्न्यो ऽपच्छिद्येत पुनर् यज्ञे सर्ववेदसं दद्यात् ॥
15.6.43.a.m: If the udgātṛ should break off later, he should give his entire property at the renewed sacrifice.

15.6.44.a.d: यद्य् आर्भवे पवमाने ऽपच्छिद्येत सर्वप्रायश्चित्तं जुहुयात् ॥
15.6.44.a.m: If he should break off during the Ārbhava Pavamāna, he should offer the all-expiation.

15.7.1.a.s: yadi soma upadasyet suvarṇam̐ hiraṇyaṃ dvaidhaṃ vibhajyārdham ṛjīṣe 'ntardhāyāpo 'vanayed ardham abhyunnīya grahaiḥ pracaret //
15.7.1.a.d: यदि सोम उपदस्येत् सुवर्णम्̐ हिरण्यं द्वैधं विभज्यार्धम् ऋजीषे ऽन्तर्धायापो ऽवनयेद् अर्धम् अभ्युन्नीय ग्रहैः प्रचरेत् ॥
15.7.1.a.m: If the soma should run short, having divided a piece of gold into two parts and having placed one half in the soma residue, he should pour in water; having drawn [soma] with the other half, he should proceed with the cups.

15.7.2.a.s: brahmaṇa udgātre hotre 'dhvaryave ca caturo varān dadyāt //
15.7.2.a.d: ब्रह्मण उद्गात्रे होत्रे ऽध्वर्यवे च चतुरो वरान् दद्यात् ॥
15.7.2.a.m: He should give four choice gifts: to the brahman priest, to the udgātṛ, to the hotṛ, and to the adhvaryu.

15.7.3.a.s: yady āgrayaṇaḥ skanded upa vā dasyed itaragrahebhyo nigṛhṇīyāt / yadītare grahāḥ skandeyur upa vā dasyeyur āgrayaṇān nigṛhṇīyāt / anyāñ chukrād dhruvāc ca //
15.7.3.a.d: यद्य् आग्रयणः स्कन्देद् उप वा दस्येद् इतरग्रहेभ्यो निगृह्णीयात् । यदीतरे ग्रहाः स्कन्देयुर् उप वा दस्येयुर् आग्रयणान् निगृह्णीयात् । अन्याञ् छुक्राद् ध्रुवाच् च ॥
15.7.3.a.m: If the Āgrayaṇa cup should spill or run short, he should draw from the other cups; if the other cups should spill or run short, he should draw from the Āgrayaṇa cup, except from the Śukra and the Dhruva cups.

15.7.4.a.s: droṇakalaśān nigṛhṇātīti sarvagrahāṇām̐ skannānām upadastānāṃ veti vijñāyate //
15.7.4.a.d: द्रोणकलशान् निगृह्णातीति सर्वग्रहाणाम्̐ स्कन्नानाम् उपदस्तानां वेति विज्ञायते ॥
15.7.4.a.m: It is known [from the Brāhmaṇa]: 'He draws from the wooden vat if all the cups have spilled or run short.'

15.7.5.a.s: yadi dhruvaḥ skandet \\ āyurdā asi dhruva \ āyur me dehi \\ iti varcodā asi dhurva \ varco me dehi \\ iti tanūpā asi dhruva \ tanvaṃ me pāhi \\ ity abhimantrya varaṃ dadāti //
15.7.5.a.d: यदि ध्रुवः स्कन्देत् \\ आयुर्दा असि ध्रुव \ आयुर् मे देहि \\ इति वर्चोदा असि धुर्व \ वर्चो मे देहि \\ इति तनूपा असि ध्रुव \ तन्वं मे पाहि \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य वरं ददाति ॥
15.7.5.a.m: If the Dhruva cup should spill, having addressed it with: 'You are the giver of life, O Dhruva; give me life! You are the giver of splendor, O Dhruva; give me splendor! You are the protector of the body, O Dhruva; protect my body!', he gives a choice gift.

15.7.6.a.s: yady upadasyet suvarṇam̐ hiraṇyaṃ traidhaṃ vibhajya svāhā diva āpyāyasva \\ iti prathamam avadhāyāpyāyayati //
15.7.6.a.d: यद्य् उपदस्येत् सुवर्णम्̐ हिरण्यं त्रैधं विभज्य स्वाहा दिव आप्यायस्व \\ इति प्रथमम् अवधायाप्याययति ॥
15.7.6.a.m: If it should run short, having divided a piece of gold into three parts and having placed the first in [it] with: 'Svāhā! Swell from the sky!', he swells it.

15.7.7.a.s: svāhāntarikṣādāpyāyasva \\ iti dvitīyam / svāhā pṛthivyā āpyāyasva \\ iti tṛtīyam //
15.7.7.a.d: स्वाहान्तरिक्षादाप्यायस्व \\ इति द्वितीयम् । स्वाहा पृथिव्या आप्यायस्व \\ इति तृतीयम् ॥
15.7.7.a.m: 'Svāhā! Swell from the intermediate space!', with the second; 'Svāhā! Swell from the earth!', with the third.

15.7.8.a.s: adhvaro yajño 'yam astu devās \\ oṣadhībhyaḥ paśubhyo no dhanāya \ viśvasmai bhūtāyādhvaro 'si \ sa pinvasva ghṛtavad deva yajñasya \ dhruvā dyaur dhruvā pṛthivī \ dhruvaṃ viśvam idaṃ jagat / \ dhruvā ha parvatā ime \ dhruvo rājā viśām ayam // \ ihaivaidhi mā vyathiṣṭāḥ \ parvata ivāvicācaliḥ / \ indra iveha dhruvas tiṣṭha \\ iha rāṣṭram u dhāraya / \ abhitiṣṭha pṛtanyatas \\ adhare santu śatravaḥ / \ indra iva vṛtrahā tiṣṭha \\ apaḥ kṣetrāṇi saṃjayan // \ indra enam adīdharat \\ dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣā / \ tasmai devā adhibruvan \\ ayaṃ ca brahmaṇaspatir iti catasṛbhir abhimantrya varaṃ dadāti //
15.7.8.a.d: अध्वरो यज्ञो ऽयम् अस्तु देवास् \\ ओषधीभ्यः पशुभ्यो नो धनाय \ विश्वस्मै भूतायाध्वरो ऽसि \ स पिन्वस्व घृतवद् देव यज्ञस्य \ ध्रुवा द्यौर् ध्रुवा पृथिवी \ ध्रुवं विश्वम् इदं जगत् । \ ध्रुवा ह पर्वता इमे \ ध्रुवो राजा विशाम् अयम् ॥ \ इहैवैधि मा व्यथिष्टाः \ पर्वत इवाविचाचलिः । \ इन्द्र इवेह ध्रुवस् तिष्ठ \\ इह राष्ट्रम् उ धारय । \ अभितिष्ठ पृतन्यतस् \\ अधरे सन्तु शत्रवः । \ इन्द्र इव वृत्रहा तिष्ठ \\ अपः क्षेत्राणि संजयन् ॥ \ इन्द्र एनम् अदीधरत् \\ ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण हविषा । \ तस्मै देवा अधिब्रुवन् \\ अयं च ब्रह्मणस्पतिर् इति चतसृभिर् अभिमन्त्र्य वरं ददाति ॥
15.7.8.a.m: "May this sacrifice be non-injurious, O gods, / for plants, for animals, for our wealth! / You are non-injurious to all creation; / as such, swell rich in ghee, of the divine sacrifice! / Firm is heaven, firm is the earth; / firm is this entire universe; / firm indeed are these mountains; / firm is this king of the subjects. / Be here indeed; do not waver, / unmoving like a mountain; / stand firm here like Indra, / and uphold the realm here! / Trample down those who fight against us; / may our enemies be laid low! / Stand like Indra, slayer of Vṛtra, / winning waters and fields! / Indra has upheld him, / firm with the firm oblation; / to him the gods have spoken favor, / and so too this Brahmaṇaspati"—having addressed [the soma] with these four [verses], he gives a boon.

15.7.9.a.s: yadi nārāśam̐sam̐ skanded yam adhvaryur uttaraṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇīyāt / taṃ vaṣaṭkārānuvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā \\ āpyāyasva madintama \\ iti tasmād enam āpyāyayati tenainaṃ bhakṣavantaṃ karoti //
15.7.9.a.d: यदि नाराशम्̐सम्̐ स्कन्देद् यम् अध्वर्युर् उत्तरं ग्रहं गृह्णीयात् । तं वषट्कारानुवषट्कृते हुत्वा \\ आप्यायस्व मदिन्तम \\ इति तस्माद् एनम् आप्याययति तेनैनं भक्षवन्तं करोति ॥
15.7.9.a.m: If a Nārāśaṃsa cup should spill, whatever subsequent cup the adhvaryu draws—having offered it after the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call [are made], he swells this [Nārāśaṃsa cup] from that one with the words, "Swell, O most exhilarating one!" and thereby makes it possessed of a portion for consumption.

15.7.10.a.s: devāñ janam agan yajñas \\ iti prātaḥsavane somam̐ skannam abhimantrayeta / gandharvāñ janam agan yajñas \\ iti mādhyaṃdine / pitṝñ janam agan yajñas \\ iti tṛtīyasavane / apa oṣadhīr vanaspatīñ janam agan yajñas \\ iti naktam / dyāvāpṛthivī janam agan yajñas \\ iti / tiroahniyān some somam abhigṛhya nidadhāti //
15.7.10.a.d: देवाञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \\ इति प्रातःसवने सोमम्̐ स्कन्नम् अभिमन्त्रयेत । गन्धर्वाञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \\ इति माध्यंदिने । पितॄञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \\ इति तृतीयसवने । अप ओषधीर् वनस्पतीञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \\ इति नक्तम् । द्यावापृथिवी जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \\ इति । तिरोअह्नियान् सोमे सोमम् अभिगृह्य निदधाति ॥
15.7.10.a.m: With the words, "The sacrifice has gone to the divine folk," he addresses spilled soma at the morning pressing; with "The sacrifice has gone to the gandharva folk," at the midday pressing; with "The sacrifice has gone to the fathers' folk," at the third pressing; with "The sacrifice has gone to the waters, plants, and trees folk," at night; with "The sacrifice has gone to the heaven and earth folk," [at any other time]. In the case of soma kept overnight, he takes a portion of soma into the soma and sets it down.

15.7.11.a.s: pṛṣadājyam̐ skanded yady athānyad dadhi pṛṣadājyaṃ gṛhītvā drapsaś caskanda \ mano jyotir juṣatām iti sam̐hitābhyām ekāhutiṃ juhoti //
15.7.11.a.d: पृषदाज्यम्̐ स्कन्देद् यद्य् अथान्यद् दधि पृषदाज्यं गृहीत्वा द्रप्सश् चस्कन्द \ मनो ज्योतिर् जुषताम् इति सम्̐हिताभ्याम् एकाहुतिं जुहोति ॥
15.7.11.a.m: If clotted butter should spill, then, having taken other curd for clotted butter, he offers a single oblation with the two combined [verses], "A drop spilled..." [and] "May the mind enjoy the light..."

15.7.12.a.s: yady ṛtugrahaiḥ pracarantau muhyeyātāṃ visṛṣṭadhenāḥ sarito ghṛtaścutas \\ vasanto grīṣmo madhumati varṣāḥ \ śarad dhemanta ṛtavo mayobhuvas \\ udapruṣo nabhasī saṃvasāthām / \ ā naḥ prajāṃ janayatu prajāpatir \ dhātā dadātu parivatsaro naḥ / \ saṃvatsara ṛtubhiś cākrapāṇas \\ mayi puṣṭiṃ puṣṭipatir dadhātu // \ ā devānām \\ tvam agne vratapā asi \ yad vo vayaṃ pramināma vratāni / \ madhuś ca mādhavaś ca \ vāsantikāv ṛtū / \ imaṃ yajñam avantu \ te mām avantu \ anu va ārabhe \\ anu mārabhadhvam̐ svāhā \\ ity etaiḥ saha daśabhir ṛgyajurbhir daśāhutīr juhoti / pratyāhuti varaṃ dadāti //
15.7.12.a.d: यद्य् ऋतुग्रहैः प्रचरन्तौ मुह्येयातां विसृष्टधेनाः सरितो घृतश्चुतस् \\ वसन्तो ग्रीष्मो मधुमति वर्षाः \ शरद् धेमन्त ऋतवो मयोभुवस् \\ उदप्रुषो नभसी संवसाथाम् । \ आ नः प्रजां जनयतु प्रजापतिर् \ धाता ददातु परिवत्सरो नः । \ संवत्सर ऋतुभिश् चाक्रपाणस् \\ मयि पुष्टिं पुष्टिपतिर् दधातु ॥ \ आ देवानाम् \\ त्वम् अग्ने व्रतपा असि \ यद् वो वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि । \ मधुश् च माधवश् च \ वासन्तिकाव् ऋतू । \ इमं यज्ञम् अवन्तु \ ते माम् अवन्तु \ अनु व आरभे \\ अनु मारभध्वम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इत्य् एतैः सह दशभिर् ऋग्यजुर्भिर् दशाहुतीर् जुहोति । प्रत्याहुति वरं ददाति ॥
15.7.12.a.m: If the two [priests] performing the rites with the seasonal cups should become confused, with the verses: "With udders flowing, the streams dripping ghee, / spring, summer, the rainy season rich in sweet drink, / autumn, winter, the seasons that bring joy, / spraying waters, may the two atmospheres dwell together! / May Prajāpati generate offspring for us, / may the year-regulator Dhātṛ grant us [life]; / may the Year, rolling along with the seasons, / may the lord of nourishment place nourishment in me!" / "Hither of the gods..." / "You, O Agni, are the guardian of vows..." / "Whatever vows of yours we may break..." / "Madhu and Mādhava, / the two seasons belonging to spring, / may they protect this sacrifice, / may they protect me! / I commence after you; / commence after me, svāhā!"—together with these ten ṛc and yajus mantras he offers ten oblations. At each oblation, he gives a boon.

15.7.13.a.s: yadi somaḥ skandet \\ brahman somo 'skān iti brahmaṇa āvedya yatra skandet tad apo ninīya \\ abhūd devaḥ savitā vandyo nu nas \\ idānīm ahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ / \ vi yo ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ \ śreṣṭhaṃ no atra draviṇaṃ yathā dadhat \\ ity abhimantrya hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre \\ iti juhuyāt //
15.7.13.a.d: यदि सोमः स्कन्देत् \\ ब्रह्मन् सोमो ऽस्कान् इति ब्रह्मण आवेद्य यत्र स्कन्देत् तद् अपो निनीय \\ अभूद् देवः सविता वन्द्यो नु नस् \\ इदानीम् अह्न उपवाच्यो नृभिः । \ वि यो रत्ना भजति मानवेभ्यः \ श्रेष्ठं नो अत्र द्रविणं यथा दधत् \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे \\ इति जुहुयात् ॥
15.7.13.a.m: If soma should spill, having informed the brahman with the words, "O brahman, the soma has spilled," and having poured water where it spilled, having addressed it with: "Divine Savitṛ has now become worthy of our praise, / at this time of the day to be invoked by men, / he who distributes treasures to the mortals, / so that he may bestow the best wealth upon us here," he offers with: "The Golden Germ arose in the beginning..."

15.7.14.a.m: If he should initiate a chant over an unconsumed soma cup...

15.7.15.a.s: indur hinvānam avāgat \\ indor ubhayoḥ somāḥ sāma sṛkṣata divyāś ca pārthivāś ca \ tasya ta indrapītasya madhumata upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi \\ ity abhivṛṣṭasya somasya bhakṣayati //
15.7.15.a.d: इन्दुर् हिन्वानम् अवागत् \\ इन्दोर् उभयोः सोमाः साम सृक्षत दिव्याश् च पार्थिवाश् च \ तस्य त इन्द्रपीतस्य मधुमत उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि \\ इत्य् अभिवृष्टस्य सोमस्य भक्षयति ॥
15.7.15.a.m: With the words, "The drop came down stimulating; / of the drop both earthly and heavenly somas have released the chant; / of that which has been drunk by Indra, sweet, invited, invited I partake," he consumes the soma upon which rain has fallen.

15.7.16.a.s: yadi dīkṣato 'vakiret \\ apsv agne \\ ity eṣā / tapo ṣv agne antarām̐ amitrān
15.7.16.a.d: यदि दीक्षतो ऽवकिरेत् \\ अप्स्व् अग्ने \\ इत्य् एषा । तपो ष्व् अग्ने अन्तराम्̐ अमित्रान्
15.7.16.a.m: If the consecrated person should discharge semen, [he performs an expiation with] this verse: "In the waters, O Agni..."; [and with] "Burn well, O Agni, the inner enemies..."

15.7.16.b.s: yo naḥ sanutyo abhidāsad agne \ yo antaro mitramaho 'vanuṣyāt / \ tam ajarebhir vṛṣabhis tapa svais \ tapā tapasva tapasā tapiṣṭha //
15.7.16.b.d: यो नः सनुत्यो अभिदासद् अग्ने \ यो अन्तरो मित्रमहो ऽवनुष्यात् । \ तम् अजरेभिर् वृषभिस् तप स्वैस् \ तपा तपस्व तपसा तपिष्ठ ॥
15.7.16.b.m: "He who, far off, would harm us, O Agni, / he who, close by, would plot evil, O you honored by friends, / burn him with your unfading bulls; / burn, O hot one, with your most fervent heat!"

15.7.16.c.s: sa smā kṛṇotu ketum ā \ naktaṃ cid dūra āsate / \ pāvako yad vanaspatīn \ prāsmā minoty ajaraḥ / \ nahi te agne tanuvai \ krūraṃ cakāra martyaḥ / \ kapir babhasti tejanam \\ svaṃ jarāyu gaur iva / \ meṣa iva yad upa ca vi ca śarvarī \ yad apsuragroruparasya khādati / \ śīrṣṇā giro vakṣasā vakṣaṇāṃ jayan \\ am̐śūn babhasti haritebhir āsabhis \\ ity etaiḥ saha daśabhir ṛgyajurbhir daśāhutīr juhoti / pratyāhuti varān dadāti //
15.7.16.c.d: स स्मा कृणोतु केतुम् आ \ नक्तं चिद् दूर आसते । \ पावको यद् वनस्पतीन् \ प्रास्मा मिनोत्य् अजरः । \ नहि ते अग्ने तनुवै \ क्रूरं चकार मर्त्यः । \ कपिर् बभस्ति तेजनम् \\ स्वं जरायु गौर् इव । \ मेष इव यद् उप च वि च शर्वरी \ यद् अप्सुरग्रोरुपरस्य खादति । \ शीर्ष्णा गिरो वक्षसा वक्षणां जयन् \\ अम्̐शून् बभस्ति हरितेभिर् आसभिस् \\ इत्य् एतैः सह दशभिर् ऋग्यजुर्भिर् दशाहुतीर् जुहोति । प्रत्याहुति वरान् ददाति ॥
15.7.16.c.m: "May he indeed make a beacon; / even at night they sit far off, / when the purifier destroys the trees, / he the unaging one. / For no mortal has done / harm to your body, O Agni; / the monkey chews the shaft, / like a cow its own afterbirth. / When like a ram he approaches and departs in the night, / when in the waters he eats the tip of the lower one, / winning the songs with his head, the breasts with his chest, / he chews the stalks with his green mouths"—together with these ten ṛc and yajus mantras he offers ten oblations. At each oblation, he gives boons.

15.7.17.a.s: yad devā devaheḍanam iti vā ( daśāhutīr hutvā pavamānaḥ suvarjanas \\ ity etenānuvākenābhiṣiñcet ) //
15.7.17.a.d: यद् देवा देवहेडनम् इति वा ( दशाहुतीर् हुत्वा पवमानः सुवर्जनस् \\ इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेनाभिषिञ्चेत् ) ॥
15.7.17.a.m: Or, having offered ten oblations with "Whatever offense to the gods, O gods...", he sprinkles [the sacrificer] with this section: "Pavamāna, who produces the sun..."

15.7.18.a.s: yadi hutāhutau somau sam̐sṛjeyātām antaḥparidhy āhavanīyād aṅgāraṃ nirvartya yajñasya hi stha ṛtviyau \\ indrāgnī cetanasya ca \ hutāhutasya tṛpyatam \ ahutasya hutasya ca \ hutasya cāhutasya ca \\ ahutasya hutasya ca \\ indrāgnī asya somasya \ vītaṃ pibataṃ juṣethām̐ svāhā \\ iti hutāhutau somau juhuyāt //
15.7.18.a.d: यदि हुताहुतौ सोमौ सम्̐सृजेयाताम् अन्तःपरिध्य् आहवनीयाद् अङ्गारं निर्वर्त्य यज्ञस्य हि स्थ ऋत्वियौ \\ इन्द्राग्नी चेतनस्य च \ हुताहुतस्य तृप्यतम् \ अहुतस्य हुतस्य च \ हुतस्य चाहुतस्य च \\ अहुतस्य हुतस्य च \\ इन्द्राग्नी अस्य सोमस्य \ वीतं पिबतं जुषेथाम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इति हुताहुतौ सोमौ जुहुयात् ॥
15.7.18.a.m: If an offered soma and an unoffered soma should become mixed together, having rolled an ember out from the āhavanīya fire within the enclosing sticks, he offers the offered and unoffered somas with: "For you two are the seasonal [priests] of the sacrifice / and of the conscious [sacrificer], O Indra and Agni! / Be satisfied with the offered and the unoffered, / with the unoffered and the offered, / with the offered and the unoffered, / with the unoffered and the offered! / O Indra and Agni, partake of this soma, / drink, enjoy it, svāhā!"

15.7.19.a.s: mā no dhvariṣuḥ pitaro mota vīrān \ mā naḥ sabandhur uta vānyabandhuḥ / \ mā no duścakṣā aghaśam̐sa īśata \\ āhuto 'yaṃ yajñam apyetu devās \\ iti hutāhutau somau bhakṣayati //
15.7.19.a.d: मा नो ध्वरिषुः पितरो मोत वीरान् \ मा नः सबन्धुर् उत वान्यबन्धुः । \ मा नो दुश्चक्षा अघशम्̐स ईशत \\ आहुतो ऽयं यज्ञम् अप्येतु देवास् \\ इति हुताहुतौ सोमौ भक्षयति ॥
15.7.19.a.m: With the words, "May the fathers not injure us, nor our heroes; / may neither our kinsman nor a stranger [harm us]; / may the evil-eyed and the slanderer not have power over us; / may this offered [soma] go to the sacrifice, O gods!" he consumes the offered and unoffered somas.

15.7.20.a.s: mā yajamānaṃ tamo vidat \\ martvijo mā imāḥ prajāḥ / \ mā yaḥ somam imaṃ pibāt \ sam̐sṛṣṭam ubhayaṃ kṛtam iti bhakṣayantam abhimantrayate //
15.7.20.a.d: मा यजमानं तमो विदत् \\ मर्त्विजो मा इमाः प्रजाः । \ मा यः सोमम् इमं पिबात् \ सम्̐सृष्टम् उभयं कृतम् इति भक्षयन्तम् अभिमन्त्रयते ॥
15.7.20.a.m: With the words, "May darkness not reach the sacrificer, / nor the priests, nor these offspring; / may it not reach whoever drinks this soma / that has been mixed and doubly prepared!" he addresses [the priest] while consuming [it].

15.7.21.a.s: saptartvijaḥ sapta sadām̐sy eṣām \\ daśa kṣipo aśvinā pañca vājāḥ / \ prāṇo vyāno 'pāno mana ākūtam agniḥ \ svāhākṛtam̐ havir adantu devāḥ // \ prajāpate na tvad etān iti bhakṣaṃ vyāpannam uttarārdhapūrvārdha uparave 'vanayet //
15.7.21.a.d: सप्तर्त्विजः सप्त सदाम्̐स्य् एषाम् \\ दश क्षिपो अश्विना पञ्च वाजाः । \ प्राणो व्यानो ऽपानो मन आकूतम् अग्निः \ स्वाहाकृतम्̐ हविर् अदन्तु देवाः ॥ \ प्रजापते न त्वद् एतान् इति भक्षं व्यापन्नम् उत्तरार्धपूर्वार्ध उपरवे ऽवनयेत् ॥
15.7.21.a.m: "Seven are the officiating priests, seven their sitting places; / ten are the fingers, the two Aśvins, five the provisions; / in-breath, out-breath, diffused breath, mind, intention, Agni: / may the gods eat the oblation prepared with the svāhā-call!" [and] with "O Prajāpati, none other than you [encompasses] these..." he pours the spoiled consumption portion into the sounding-hole in the northeastern quarter.

15.7.23.a.s: skannā dyauḥ skannā pṛthivī \ skannaṃ viśvam idaṃ jagat / \ skannādo viśvā bhūtāni \ praskannāj jāyatām̐ haviḥ //
15.7.23.a.d: स्कन्ना द्यौः स्कन्ना पृथिवी \ स्कन्नं विश्वम् इदं जगत् । \ स्कन्नादो विश्वा भूतानि \ प्रस्कन्नाज् जायताम्̐ हविः ॥
15.7.23.a.m: "Spilled is heaven, spilled is the earth; / spilled is this entire universe; / all creatures eat from what is spilled; / from what has spilled forth may the oblation arise!

15.7.23.b.s: iha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvam \ ihāśvā iha pūruṣāḥ //
15.7.23.b.d: इह गावः प्रजायध्वम् \ इहाश्वा इह पूरुषाः ॥
15.7.23.b.m: Here, O cows, multiply; / here, O horses; here, O men!

15.7.23.c.m: And here may abundance of wealth, / accompanied by a thousand sacrificial gifts, settle down!

15.7.23.d.s: ayaṃ yajño vardhatāṃ gobhir aśvair \ iyaṃ vediḥ svapatyā suvīrā / \ idaṃ barhir ati barhīm̐ṣy anyā \\ imaṃ yajñaṃ viśve avantu devāḥ //
15.7.23.d.d: अयं यज्ञो वर्धतां गोभिर् अश्वैर् \ इयं वेदिः स्वपत्या सुवीरा । \ इदं बर्हिर् अति बर्हीम्̐ष्य् अन्या \\ इमं यज्ञं विश्वे अवन्तु देवाः ॥
15.7.23.d.m: May this sacrifice increase with cattle and horses; / may this altar be blessed with good offspring, with good heroes; / may this sacred grass surpass other sacred grasses; / may all the gods favor this sacrifice!"

15.7.23.e.s: payasvatīroṣadhayas \\ ity etābhiḥ pṛṣadājyam̐ skannam abhimantryāpo 'bhyavahṛtya pātraṃ nirṇijya punar niṣṭapya nidadhāti / tasmin hiraṇyam̐ śatamānam avadhāya \\ ekam iṣe \ viṣṇus tvānvetu \\ iti vaiṣṇavyarcāthānyad dadhi pṛṣadājyaṃ gṛhītvā drapsaś caskanda \\ ity abhimṛśyāśvenāvaghrāpya sādayati //
15.7.23.e.d: पयस्वतीरोषधयस् \\ इत्य् एताभिः पृषदाज्यम्̐ स्कन्नम् अभिमन्त्र्यापो ऽभ्यवहृत्य पात्रं निर्णिज्य पुनर् निष्टप्य निदधाति । तस्मिन् हिरण्यम्̐ शतमानम् अवधाय \\ एकम् इषे \ विष्णुस् त्वान्वेतु \\ इति वैष्णव्यर्चाथान्यद् दधि पृषदाज्यं गृहीत्वा द्रप्सश् चस्कन्द \\ इत्य् अभिमृश्याश्वेनावघ्राप्य सादयति ॥
15.7.23.e.m: Having addressed the spilled clotted butter with [the verses], 'Rich in milk the plants...', and having thrown [it] into water, cleansed the vessel, and heated it again over the fire, he places it down. Having placed a gold piece of one hundred mānas weight into it, with the verse to Viṣṇu, 'One for food, may Viṣṇu go after you...', and then taking another portion of curds [and] clotted butter, touching it with, 'The drop spilt...', and having made a horse smell it, he sets it down.

15.7.24.a.s: yad apāmṛkṣac chakunir \ mukhena nirṛte tava / \ agniṣ ṭat sarvam̐ śundhatu \ havyavāḍ ghṛtasūdanas \\ iti śakunyavamṛṣṭaṃ tasyaitad eva prāyaścittaṃ nirlikhyate 'tra pātram //
15.7.24.a.d: यद् अपामृक्षच् छकुनिर् \ मुखेन निरृते तव । \ अग्निष् टत् सर्वम्̐ शुन्धतु \ हव्यवाड् घृतसूदनस् \\ इति शकुन्यवमृष्टं तस्यैतद् एव प्रायश्चित्तं निर्लिख्यते ऽत्र पात्रम् ॥
15.7.24.a.m: 'What the bird has touched with its beak, O Nirṛti, of yours, may Agni, the bearer of oblations who clarifies ghee, purify all that'—[with this verse he addresses] what has been touched by a bird. Its expiation is this very [rite]. Here the vessel is scraped clean.

15.7.25.a.s: yad avālikṣac chvapāt \\ mukhena nirṛte tava / \ agniṣ ṭat sarvaṃ śundhatu \ havyavāḍ ghṛtasūdanas \\ iti śvāpadāvalīḍham abhimantrayate / tasyaitad eva prāyaścittam / ( abhyavaharaṇādi pūrvavat ) / nātra pātraṃ prayujyate //
15.7.25.a.d: यद् अवालिक्षच् छ्वपात् \\ मुखेन निरृते तव । \ अग्निष् टत् सर्वं शुन्धतु \ हव्यवाड् घृतसूदनस् \\ इति श्वापदावलीढम् अभिमन्त्रयते । तस्यैतद् एव प्रायश्चित्तम् । ( अभ्यवहरणादि पूर्ववत् ) । नात्र पात्रं प्रयुज्यते ॥
15.7.25.a.m: 'What the wild beast has licked with its mouth, O Nirṛti, of yours, may Agni, the bearer of oblations who clarifies ghee, purify all that'—with this [verse] he addresses what has been licked by a wild beast. Its expiation is this very [rite]. (The throwing into water and the rest are as before.) The vessel is not used here.

15.8.1.a.s: yad asya pāre rajasas \\ iti juhuyāt / yadi paśur upākṛto vepeta niṣīded vāśyetocchrayet palāyetā kāmasaṃjñapane ca / yasmād bhīṣāvepiṣṭhās \ tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi / \ prajābhyaḥ sarvābhyo mṛḍa \ namo rudrāya mīḍuṣe \\ iti dvitīyāṃ vepāmāne //
15.8.1.a.d: यद् अस्य पारे रजसस् \\ इति जुहुयात् । यदि पशुर् उपाकृतो वेपेत निषीदेद् वाश्येतोच्छ्रयेत् पलायेता कामसंज्ञपने च । यस्माद् भीषावेपिष्ठास् \ ततो नो अभयं कृधि । \ प्रजाभ्यः सर्वाभ्यो मृड \ नमो रुद्राय मीडुषे \\ इति द्वितीयां वेपामाने ॥
15.8.1.a.m: He should offer with: 'Beyond the realm of this dust...'. If the animal, when dedicated, should tremble, lie down, cry out, rear up, or run away, and in the case of unintentional killing: 'From which fear you trembled, from that make us free from fear; be gracious to all creatures, homage to the bounteous Rudra'—[he offers] the second [oblation] with this [verse] if it trembles.

15.8.2.a.s: yasmād bhīṣā nyaṣadas \\ iti dvitīyāṃ niṣaṇṇe //
15.8.2.a.d: यस्माद् भीषा न्यषदस् \\ इति द्वितीयां निषण्णे ॥
15.8.2.a.m: 'From which fear you sat down...'—[he offers] the second [oblation] with this [verse] if it has sat down.

15.8.3.a.s: ud usra tiṣṭha pratitiṣṭha mā riṣas \\ memaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānaṃ ca rīriṣaḥ / \ suvarge loke yajamānam̐ hi dhehi \ śaṃ na edhi dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade \\ ity usram utthāpayet //
15.8.3.a.d: उद् उस्र तिष्ठ प्रतितिष्ठ मा रिषस् \\ मेमं यज्ञं यजमानं च रीरिषः । \ सुवर्गे लोके यजमानम्̐ हि धेहि \ शं न एधि द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे \\ इत्य् उस्रम् उत्थापयेत् ॥
15.8.3.a.m: 'Stand up, O bull, stand firm, do not be harmed; do not harm this sacrifice and the sacrificer. Place the sacrificer in the heavenly world; be auspicious to our two-footed, auspicious to our four-footed'—with this [verse] he should make the bull stand up.

15.8.4.a.s: uc chāga \\ iti cchāgam / un meṣa \\ iti meṣam / ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye \\ iti dvitīyām / ūrdhvo naḥ pāhy am̐haso ni ketunā \ viśvam̐ sam atriṇaṃ daha / \ kṛdhī na ūrdhvāṃ carathāya jīvase \ vidā deveṣu no duvas \\ iti tṛtīyām //
15.8.4.a.d: उच् छाग \\ इति च्छागम् । उन् मेष \\ इति मेषम् । ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतये \\ इति द्वितीयाम् । ऊर्ध्वो नः पाह्य् अम्̐हसो नि केतुना \ विश्वम्̐ सम् अत्रिणं दह । \ कृधी न ऊर्ध्वां चरथाय जीवसे \ विदा देवेषु नो दुवस् \\ इति तृतीयाम् ॥
15.8.4.a.m: 'Arise, O goat'—in the case of a goat. 'Arise, O ram'—in the case of a ram. With 'Erect unto us for help...' [he offers] the second [oblation].
